title: Karin Magana 1:1
content: 1 Karin maganar Solomon ɗan Dawuda, sarkin Isra’ila.

title: Karin Magana 1:2
content: 2 Ga karin magana da za su taimake ka don samun hikima da horo; don ganewa kalmomi masu zurfi;

title: Karin Magana 1:3
content: 3 don neman rayuwa ta horo da kuma ta hankali, kana yin abin da yake daidai, mai adalci da kuma wanda ya dace;

title: Karin Magana 1:4
content: 4 don sa marar azanci yă yi hankali, yă sa matasa su sani, su kuma iya rarrabewa,

title: Karin Magana 1:5
content: 5 bari masu hikima su saurara, su kuma ƙara ga saninsu, bari masu tunani kuma su sami jagora,

title: Karin Magana 1:6
content: 6 don su fahimci karin magana da kuma misalai, kalmomi da kuma kacici-kacici masu hikima.

title: Karin Magana 1:7
content: 7 Tsoron Ubangiji shi ne masomin ilimi, amma wawaye sun rena hikima da horo.

title: Karin Magana 1:8
content: 8 Ɗana, ka saurari umarnin mahaifinka kada kuma ka ƙyale koyarwar mahaifiyarka.

title: Karin Magana 1:9
content: 9 Za su zama kayan ado don su inganta ka da kuma sarƙar wuya don su yi wa wuyanka ado.

title: Karin Magana 1:10
content: 10 Ɗana, in masu zunubi sun jarabce ka, kada ka yarda.

title: Karin Magana 1:11
content: 11 In suka ce, “Zo mu tafi; mu yi kwanton ɓauna, mu nemi wani mu kashe, mu fāɗa wa marasa laifi;

title: Karin Magana 1:12
content: 12 mu haɗiye su da rai gaba ɗaya kamar kabari, kamar waɗanda suke gangarawa zuwa rami;

title: Karin Magana 1:13
content: 13 za mu sami dukiya masu daraja iri-iri, mu kuma cika gidajenmu da ganima;

title: Karin Magana 1:14
content: 14 ka haɗa kai da mu, za mu kuwa raba abin da muka sato”

title: Karin Magana 1:15
content: 15 ɗana, kada ka tafi tare da su, kada ka taka ƙafarka a hanyarsu;

title: Karin Magana 1:16
content: 16 gama ƙafafunsu kan yi sauri ga yin zunubi, suna saurin yin kisankai.

title: Karin Magana 1:17
content: 17 Ba shi da amfani a kafa tarko a idanun dukan tsuntsaye!

title: Karin Magana 1:18
content: 18 Waɗannan irin mutane kansu suke kafa wa tarko; ba sa kama kome, sai rayukansu!

title: Karin Magana 1:19
content: 19 Dukan waɗanda suke neman ribar da ba a samu a hanya mai kyau; ƙarshen wannan yakan ɗauke rayukansu.

title: Karin Magana 1:20
content: 20 Hikima tana kira da ƙarfi a kan titi, tana ɗaga muryarta a dandalin taron jama’a;

title: Karin Magana 1:21
content: 21 tana kira da ƙarfi a kan tituna masu surutu, tana yin jawabinta a hanyoyin shiga gari.

title: Karin Magana 1:22
content: 22 “Har yaushe ku da kuke marasa azanci za ku ci gaba a hanyoyinku marasa azanci? Har yaushe ku masu ba’a za ku yi ta murna cikin ba’arku wawaye kuma ku ƙi ilimi?

title: Karin Magana 1:23
content: 23 Da a ce kun saurari tsawatata, da na faɗa muku dukan abin da yake zuciyata in kuma sanar da ku tunanina.

title: Karin Magana 1:24
content: 24 Amma da yake kun ƙi ni sa’ad da na yi kira ba kuma wanda ya saurara sa’ad da na miƙa hannuna,

title: Karin Magana 1:25
content: 25 da yake kun ƙi dukan shawarata ba ku kuma yarda da tsawatata ba,

title: Karin Magana 1:26
content: 26 Zan yi muku dariya sa’ad da masifa ta same ku, zan yi muku ba’a sa’ad da bala’i ya same ku,

title: Karin Magana 1:27
content: 27 sa’ad da bala’i ya sha kanku kamar hadiri, sa’ad da masifa ta share ku kamar guguwa, sa’ad damuwa da wahala suka mamaye ku.

title: Karin Magana 1:28
content: 28 “Sa’an nan za su kira gare ni amma ba zan amsa ba; za su neme ni amma ba za su same ni ba.

title: Karin Magana 1:29
content: 29 Da yake sun ƙi sani ba su kuwa zaɓi tsoron Ubangiji ba,

title: Karin Magana 1:30
content: 30 da yake ba su karɓi shawarata ba suka kuwa yi kunnen ƙashi ga tsawatata,

title: Karin Magana 1:31
content: 31 za su sami sakayyar abubuwan da suka yi su kuma ƙoshi da sakayyar makircinsu.

title: Karin Magana 1:32
content: 32 Gama rashin hankalin marasa azanci zai kashe su, rashin kulawar wawaye kuma zai hallaka su;

title: Karin Magana 1:33
content: 33 amma duk wanda ya saurare ni, zai zauna lafiya yă kuma kasance da rai kwance, ba tare da tsoron lahani ba.”

title: Karin Magana 2:1
content: 1 Ɗana, in ka yarda da kalmomina ka kuma ajiye umarnaina a cikinka,

title: Karin Magana 2:2
content: 2 kana kasa kunne ga abin da yake na hikima, kana kuma yin ƙoƙari ka fahimce shi,

title: Karin Magana 2:3
content: 3 in kuma ka kira ga tsinkaya ka kuma kira da ƙarfi don ganewa,

title: Karin Magana 2:4
content: 4 in ka neme shi yadda ake neman azurfa ka kuma neme shi kamar yadda ake neman ɓoyayyiyar dukiya,

title: Karin Magana 2:5
content: 5 to, za ka gane tsoron Ubangiji ka kuma sami sanin Allah.

title: Karin Magana 2:6
content: 6 Gama Ubangiji yana ba da hikima, daga bakinsa kuma, sani da ganewa sukan fito.

title: Karin Magana 2:7
content: 7 Yana riƙe da nasara a ma’aji don masu yin gaskiya, shi ne mafaka ga waɗanda tafiyarsu ba ta da laifi,

title: Karin Magana 2:8
content: 8 gama yana tsare abin da masu adalci suke bukata yana kuma tsare hanyar amintattunsa.

title: Karin Magana 2:9
content: 9 Sa’an nan za ku fahimci abin da yake daidai da abin da yake na adalci da abin da yake gaskiya, da kowace hanya mai kyau.

title: Karin Magana 2:10
content: 10 Gama hikima za tă shiga cikin zuciyarka, sani kuma zai faranta maka rai.

title: Karin Magana 2:11
content: 11 Tsinkaya za tă tsare ka, ganewa kuma za tă yi maka jagora.

title: Karin Magana 2:12
content: 12 Hikima za tă cece ka daga hanyoyin mugayen mutane, daga kalmomin mutane masu ɓatanci,

title: Karin Magana 2:13
content: 13 waɗanda suke barin miƙaƙƙun hanyoyi don su yi tafiya a hanyoyi masu duhu,

title: Karin Magana 2:14
content: 14 waɗanda suke jin daɗin yin abin da ba shi da kyau suna kuma farin ciki a mugayen ɓatanci,

title: Karin Magana 2:15
content: 15 waɗanda hanyoyinsu karkatattu ne waɗanda kuma suke cuku-cuku a hanyoyinsu.

title: Karin Magana 2:16
content: 16 Zai kiyaye ku kuma daga mazinaciya, daga mace mai lalata, mai ƙoƙarin kama ka da daɗin bakinta,

title: Karin Magana 2:17
content: 17 wadda ta bar mijin ƙuruciyarta ta kuma ƙyale alkawarin da ta yi a gaban Allah.

title: Karin Magana 2:18
content: 18 Gama gidanta yana kai ga mutuwa hanyarta kuma ga ruhohin matattu.

title: Karin Magana 2:19
content: 19 Duk wanda ya ziyarce ta ba ya ƙara komowa ba zai ƙara komowa ga hanyar rai.

title: Karin Magana 2:20
content: 20 Don haka dole ku yi tafiya a hanyoyin mutanen kirki ku kuma yi ta bi hanyoyin adalai.

title: Karin Magana 2:21
content: 21 Gama masu aikata gaskiya za su zauna a cikin ƙasar, marasa laifi kuma za su kasance a cikinta;

title: Karin Magana 2:22
content: 22 amma za a fid da mugaye daga ƙasar, za a tumɓuke marasa aminci kuma daga gare ta.

title: Karin Magana 3:1
content: 1 Ɗana, kada ka manta da koyarwata, amma ka kiyaye umarnaina a cikin zuciyarka,

title: Karin Magana 3:2
content: 2 gama za su ƙara maka tsawon rai da shekaru masu yawa su kuma kawo maka wadata.

title: Karin Magana 3:3
content: 3 Kada ka bar ƙauna da aminci su rabu da kai; ka ɗaura su kewaye da wuyanka, ka rubuta su a allon zuciyarka.

title: Karin Magana 3:4
content: 4 Sa’an nan za ka sami tagomashi da kuma suna mai kyau a gaban Allah da kuma a gaban mutane.

title: Karin Magana 3:5
content: 5 Ka dogara ga Ubangiji da dukan zuciyarka kada kuma ka dangana ga ganewarka;

title: Karin Magana 3:6
content: 6 cikin dukan hanyoyinka ka amince da shi, zai kuwa sa hanyoyinka su miƙe.

title: Karin Magana 3:7
content: 7 Kada ka zama mai hikima a ganinka; ka ji tsoron Ubangiji ka kuma guji mugunta.

title: Karin Magana 3:8
content: 8 Wannan zai ba wa jikinka lafiya yă kuma adana ƙasusuwanka.

title: Karin Magana 3:9
content: 9 Ka girmama Ubangiji da dukan dukiyarka, ta wurin miƙa masa nunan fari na dukan amfanin gonarka;

title: Karin Magana 3:10
content: 10 ta haka rumbunanka za su cika har su zuba, randunanka kuma su cika har baki da sabon ruwan inabi.

title: Karin Magana 3:11
content: 11 Ɗana, kada ka rena horon Ubangiji kada kuma ka ƙi tsawatawarsa,

title: Karin Magana 3:12
content: 12 domin Ubangiji yakan hori waɗanda yake ƙauna, kamar yadda mahaifi yake yin wa ɗa da yake fariya da shi.

title: Karin Magana 3:13
content: 13 Mai albarka ne mutumin da ya sami hikima, mutumin da ya sami fahimi,

title: Karin Magana 3:14
content: 14 gama ta fi azurfa riba tana kuma da amfani fiye da zinariya.

title: Karin Magana 3:15
content: 15 Ta fi lu’ulu’u daraja; ba a kwatanta abin da ka fi sha’awa da ita.

title: Karin Magana 3:16
content: 16 Tsawon rai yana a cikin hannunta na dama; a hannunta na hagu kuwa akwai arziki da bangirma.

title: Karin Magana 3:17
content: 17 Hanyoyinta hanyoyi ne masu daɗi, dukan hanyoyinta kuma salama ne.

title: Karin Magana 3:18
content: 18 Ita itacen rai ne ga waɗanda suka rungume ta; waɗanda suke riƙe da ta za su zama masu albarka.

title: Karin Magana 3:19
content: 19 Ta wurin hikima Ubangiji ya kafa harsashin duniya, ta wurin fahimi ya shirya sammai inda suke;

title: Karin Magana 3:20
content: 20 ta wurin sani aka rarraba zurfafa, gizagizai kuma suka zubo raɓa.

title: Karin Magana 3:21
content: 21 Ɗana, ka riƙe sahihiyar shari’a da kuma basira, kada ka bar su su rabu da kai;

title: Karin Magana 3:22
content: 22 za su zama rai a gare ka, abin adon da zai gyara wuyanka.

title: Karin Magana 3:23
content: 23 Sa’an nan za ka bi hanyarka lafiya, ƙafarka kuwa ba zai yi tuntuɓe ba;

title: Karin Magana 3:24
content: 24 sa’ad da ka kwanta, ba za ka ji tsoro ba; sa’ad da ka kwanta, barci zai yi maka daɗi.

title: Karin Magana 3:25
content: 25 Kada ka ji tsoron masifar da za tă faru farat ɗaya ko lalacin da yakan auka wa mugaye,

title: Karin Magana 3:26
content: 26 gama Ubangiji zai zama ƙarfin halinka zai kuwa kiyaye ƙafarka daga fāɗawa a tarko.

title: Karin Magana 3:27
content: 27 Kada ka ƙi yin alheri ga duk wanda ya dace, sa’ad da kana iya yin haka.

title: Karin Magana 3:28
content: 28 Kada ka ce wa maƙwabcinka “Ka yă dakata sai gobe,” idan kana iya taimakonsa yanzu.

title: Karin Magana 3:29
content: 29 Kada ka shirya kome da zai cuci maƙwabcinka, wanda yake zama da aminci kusa da kai.

title: Karin Magana 3:30
content: 30 Kada ka zargi mutum ba dalili, sa’ad da bai yi laifi ba.

title: Karin Magana 3:31
content: 31 Kada ka ji kishin mai tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye ko ka yi sha’awar aikata ayyukansu.

title: Karin Magana 3:32
content: 32 Gama Ubangiji yana ƙyama mai aikata mugunta amma yakan rungumi adalin da ya amince da shi.

title: Karin Magana 3:33
content: 33 La’anar Ubangiji tana a gidan mugaye, amma yakan albarkaci gidan adali.

title: Karin Magana 3:34
content: 34 Yakan yi wa masu girman kai ba’a amma yakan yi wa mai sauƙinkai alheri.

title: Karin Magana 3:35
content: 35 Masu hikima sukan sami kyakkyawan suna, amma wawaye sukan ƙara wa kansu shan kunya.

title: Karin Magana 4:1
content: 1 Ku saurara ’ya’yana ga koyarwar mahaifinku; ku mai da hankali, ku sami fahimi.

title: Karin Magana 4:2
content: 2 Ina ba ku sahihiyar koyarwa, saboda haka kada ku ƙyale koyarwata.

title: Karin Magana 4:3
content: 3 Sa’ad da nake yaro a gidan mahaifina, yaro kaɗai kuma na mahaifiyata,

title: Karin Magana 4:4
content: 4 ya koya mini ya ce, “Ka riƙe kalmomina da dukan zuciyarka; ka kiyaye umarnaina za ka kuwa rayu.

title: Karin Magana 4:5
content: 5 Ka nemi hikima, ka nemi fahimi; kada ka manta da kalmomina ko ka kauce daga gare su.

title: Karin Magana 4:6
content: 6 Kada ka ƙyale hikima, za tă kuwa tsare ka; ka ƙaunace ta, za tă kuwa lura da kai.

title: Karin Magana 4:7
content: 7 Hikima ce mafi girma duka; saboda haka ka nemi hikima. Ko da za tă ci duk abin da kake da shi, ka dai nemi fahimi.

title: Karin Magana 4:8
content: 8 Ka ƙaunace ta, za tă ɗaukaka ka; ka rungume ta, za tă kuwa girmama ka.

title: Karin Magana 4:9
content: 9 Za tă zama kayan ado da za su inganta kanka tă kuma zamar maka rawanin ɗaukaka.”

title: Karin Magana 4:10
content: 10 Ka saurara, ɗana, ka yarda da abin da na faɗa, shekarun rayuwarka kuwa za su zama masu yawa.

title: Karin Magana 4:11
content: 11 Na bishe ka a hanyar hikima na kuma jagorance ka a miƙaƙƙun hanyoyi.

title: Karin Magana 4:12
content: 12 Sa’ad da kake tafiya, ba abin da zai sa ka tuntuɓe; sa’ad da kake gudu, ba za ka fāɗi ba.

title: Karin Magana 4:13
content: 13 Ka riƙe umarni, kada ka bari yă kuɓuce; ka tsare shi sosai, gama ranka ne.

title: Karin Magana 4:14
content: 14 Kada ka sa ƙafa a kan hanyar mugaye kada ka bi gurbin mugaye.

title: Karin Magana 4:15
content: 15 Ka guji mugunta, kada ka yi tafiya a kanta; juya daga gare ta ka yi tafiyarka.

title: Karin Magana 4:16
content: 16 Mugaye ba sa iya barci, sai sun aikata mugunta; ba su barci sai sun cuci wani.

title: Karin Magana 4:17
content: 17 Mugunta da ta’adi kamar ci da sha suke a gare su.

title: Karin Magana 4:18
content: 18 Hanyar adali kamar fitowar rana ce, sai ƙara haske take yi, har ta kai tsaka.

title: Karin Magana 4:19
content: 19 Amma hanyar mugaye kamar zurfin duhu ne; ba sa sanin abin da ya sa suke tuntuɓe.

title: Karin Magana 4:20
content: 20 Ɗana, ka kula da abin da nake faɗa, ka saurara sosai ga kalmomina.

title: Karin Magana 4:21
content: 21 Kada ka bari su rabu da kai, ka kiyaye su a cikin zuciyarka;

title: Karin Magana 4:22
content: 22 gama rai ne ga waɗanda suke nemansu da kuma lafiya ga dukan jikin mutum.

title: Karin Magana 4:23
content: 23 Fiye da kome duka, ka tsare zuciyarka, gama maɓulɓulan ruwan rijiyar rai ne.

title: Karin Magana 4:24
content: 24 Ka kau da muguwar magana daga bakinka; ka yi nesa da magana marar kyau daga leɓunanka.

title: Karin Magana 4:25
content: 25 Bari idanunka su dubi gaba sosai, ka kafa idanunka kai tsaye a gabanka.

title: Karin Magana 4:26
content: 26 Ka san inda ƙafafunka suke takawa ka bi hanyoyin da suke daram kawai.

title: Karin Magana 4:27
content: 27 Kada ka kauce dama ko hagu; ka kiyaye ƙafarka daga mugunta.

title: Karin Magana 5:1
content: 1 Ɗana, ka mai da hankali ga hikimata ka saurara da kyau ga kalmomin basirata,

title: Karin Magana 5:2
content: 2 don ka ci gaba da yin kome daidai leɓunanka za su adana sani.

title: Karin Magana 5:3
content: 3 Gama leɓunan mazinaciya na ɗigan zuma, maganarta tana da sulɓi fiye da mai;

title: Karin Magana 5:4
content: 4 amma a ƙarshe tana da ɗaci kamar tafashiya, mai ci kamar takobi mai kaifi biyu.

title: Karin Magana 5:5
content: 5 Ƙafafunta na kaiwa ga mutuwa; sawunta na jagora kai tsaye zuwa kabari.

title: Karin Magana 5:6
content: 6 Ba ta wani tunanin rayuwa; hanyoyinta karkatacce ne, amma ba tă sani ba.

title: Karin Magana 5:7
content: 7 Yanzu fa, ’ya’yana, ku saurare ni; kada ku juye daga abin da nake faɗa.

title: Karin Magana 5:8
content: 8 Ku yi nesa da hanyarta, kana ku je kusa da ƙofar gidanta,

title: Karin Magana 5:9
content: 9 don kada ku ba da ƙarfi mafi kyau ga waɗansu da kuma shekarunku ga wani marar imani,

title: Karin Magana 5:10
content: 10 don kada baƙi su yi biki a kan dukiyarku wahalarku ta azurta gidan wani mutum dabam.

title: Karin Magana 5:11
content: 11 A ƙarshen rayuwarku za ku yi ta nishi, sa’ad da namanku da jikinku suka zagwanye.

title: Karin Magana 5:12
content: 12 Za ku ce, “Me ya sa na ƙi horo! Me ya sa zuciyata ta ƙi gyara!

title: Karin Magana 5:13
content: 13 Ban yi biyayya da malamaina ba ko in saurari masu koyar da ni.

title: Karin Magana 5:14
content: 14 Na zo gab da hallaka gaba ɗaya a tsakiyar dukan taron.”

title: Karin Magana 5:15
content: 15 Ku sha ruwa daga tankinku, ruwa mai gudu daga rijiyarku.

title: Karin Magana 5:16
content: 16 In maɓulɓulanku suka cika suna malala har waje, rafuffukan ruwanku a dandalin jama’a?

title: Karin Magana 5:17
content: 17 Bari su zama naka kaɗai, don kada ka raba da baƙi.

title: Karin Magana 5:18
content: 18 Bari maɓulɓulanka ya zama mai albarka, bari kuma ka yi farin ciki da matar ƙuruciyarka.

title: Karin Magana 5:19
content: 19 Ƙaunatacciyar mariri, barewa mai kyan gani, bari mamanta su ishe ka kullum, bari ƙaunarta ta ɗauke hankalinka kullum.

title: Karin Magana 5:20
content: 20 Ɗana, me ya sa za ka bari mazinaciya ta ɗauke maka hankali? Don me za ka rungume matar wani?

title: Karin Magana 5:21
content: 21 Gama hanyar mutum a bayyane take a gaban Ubangiji, yana kuma lura da dukan hanyoyinsa.

title: Karin Magana 5:22
content: 22 Ayyukan mugunta na mugun mutum tarko ne gare shi; igiyoyin zunubinsa za su daure shi kankan.

title: Karin Magana 5:23
content: 23 Zai mutu saboda rashin ɗa’a yawan wawancinsa zai sa yă kauce.

title: Karin Magana 6:1
content: 1 Ɗana, in ka shirya tsaya wa maƙwabcinka don yă karɓi bashi, in ka sa hannunka don ɗaukar lamunin wani,

title: Karin Magana 6:2
content: 2 in maganarka ta taɓa kama ka, ko kalmomin bakinka sun zama maka tarko,

title: Karin Magana 6:3
content: 3 to, sai ka yi haka, ɗana don ka ’yantar da kanka; da yake ka shiga hannuwan maƙwabcinka, ka tafi ka ƙasƙantar da kanka; ka roƙi maƙwabcinka!

title: Karin Magana 6:4
content: 4 Ka hana kanka barci, ko gyangyaɗi a idanunka ma.

title: Karin Magana 6:5
content: 5 Ka ’yantar da kanka, kamar barewa daga hannun mai farauta, kamar tsuntsu daga tarkon mai kafa tarko.

title: Karin Magana 6:6
content: 6 Ku tafi wurin kyashi, ku ragwaye; ku lura da hanyoyinsa ku zama masu hikima!

title: Karin Magana 6:7
content: 7 Ba shi da jagora ba shugaba ko mai mulki,

title: Karin Magana 6:8
content: 8 duk da haka yakan yi tanade-tanadensa da rani ya kuma tattara abincinsa a lokacin girbi.

title: Karin Magana 6:9
content: 9 Har yaushe za ku kwanta a can, ku ragwaye? Yaushe za ku farka daga barcinku?

title: Karin Magana 6:10
content: 10 Ɗan barci, ɗan gyangyaɗi, ɗan naɗin hannuwa don a huta,

title: Karin Magana 6:11
content: 11 talauci kuwa zai zo kamar ’yan hari rashi kuma kamar ɗan fashi.

title: Karin Magana 6:12
content: 12 Sakare da mutumin banza wanda yana yawo da magana banza a baki,

title: Karin Magana 6:13
content: 13 wanda yake ƙyifce da ido, yana yi alama da ƙafafunsa yana kuma nuni da yatsotsinsa,

title: Karin Magana 6:14
content: 14 wanda yake ƙulla mugunta da ruɗu a cikin zuciyarsa, kullum yana tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye

title: Karin Magana 6:15
content: 15 Saboda haka masifa za tă fāɗa farat ɗaya; za a hallaka shi nan da nan, ba makawa.

title: Karin Magana 6:16
content: 16 Akwai abubuwa shida da Ubangiji ya ƙi, abubuwa bakwai da suke abin ƙyama gare shi,

title: Karin Magana 6:17
content: 17 duban reni, harshe mai ƙarya, hannuwa masu zub da jinin marar laifi,

title: Karin Magana 6:18
content: 18 zuciyar da take ƙulla mugayen dabaru, ƙafafun da suke sauri zuwa aikata mugunta,

title: Karin Magana 6:19
content: 19 mai shaidar ƙarya wanda yake zuba ƙarairayi, da kuma mutumin da yake tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye a cikin ’yan’uwa.

title: Karin Magana 6:20
content: 20 Ɗana, ka kiyaye umarnan mahaifinka kada kuma ka ƙyale koyarwar mahaifiyarka.

title: Karin Magana 6:21
content: 21 Ka ɗaura su a zuciyarka har abada; ka ɗaura su kewaye da wuyanka.

title: Karin Magana 6:22
content: 22 Sa’ad da kake tafiya, za su bishe ka; sa’ad da kake barci, za su lura da kai; sa’ad da ka farka, za su yi maka magana.

title: Karin Magana 6:23
content: 23 Gama waɗannan umarnai fitila ne, wannan koyarwa haske ne, kuma gyare-gyaren horo hanyar rayuwa ce,

title: Karin Magana 6:24
content: 24 suna kiyaye ka daga mace marar ɗa’a daga sulɓin harshen mace marar aminci.

title: Karin Magana 6:25
content: 25 Kada ka yi sha’awarta a cikin zuciyarka kada ka bar ta tă ɗauki hankalinka da idanunta.

title: Karin Magana 6:26
content: 26 Gama karuwa takan mai da kai kamar burodin kyauta, mazinaciya kuma takan farauci ranka.

title: Karin Magana 6:27
content: 27 Mutum zai iya ɗiba wuta ya zuba a cinyarsa ba tare da rigunansa sun ƙone ba?

title: Karin Magana 6:28
content: 28 Mutum zai iya yin tafi a garwashi wuta mai zafi ba tare da ƙafafunsa sun ƙone ba?

title: Karin Magana 6:29
content: 29 Haka yake da wanda ya kwana da matar wani; babu wanda ya taɓa ta da zai tafi babu hukunci.

title: Karin Magana 6:30
content: 30 Mutane ba sa ƙyale ɓarawo in ya yi sata don yă ƙosar da yunwarsa sa’ad da yake jin yunwa.

title: Karin Magana 6:31
content: 31 Duk da haka in aka kama shi, dole yă biya sau bakwai ko da yake abin zai ci dukan arzikin gidansa.

title: Karin Magana 6:32
content: 32 Amma mutumin da ya yi zina ba shi da hankali; duk wanda ya yi haka yana hallaka kansa ne.

title: Karin Magana 6:33
content: 33 Dūka da kunya ne za su zama rabonsa, kuma kunyarsa za tă dawwama.

title: Karin Magana 6:34
content: 34 Gama kishi kan tā da hasalar miji, kuma ba zai ji tausayi ba sa’ad da yake ramawa.

title: Karin Magana 6:35
content: 35 Ba zai karɓi duk wata biya ba; zai ƙi cin hanci, kome yawansu.

title: Karin Magana 7:1
content: 1 Ɗana, ka kiyaye kalmomina ka kuma ajiye umarnaina a cikinka.

title: Karin Magana 7:2
content: 2 Ka kiyaye umarnaina za ka kuwa rayu; ka tsare koyarwata kamar ƙwayar idonka.

title: Karin Magana 7:3
content: 3 Ka daure su a yatsotsinka; ka rubuta su a allon zuciyarka.

title: Karin Magana 7:4
content: 4 Ka faɗa wa hikima, “Ke ’yar’uwata ce,” ka kuma kira fahimi danginka;

title: Karin Magana 7:5
content: 5 za su kiyaye ka daga mazinaciya, daga mace marar aminci da kalmominta masu ɗaukan hankali.

title: Karin Magana 7:6
content: 6 A tagar gidana na leƙa ta labule mai rammuka.

title: Karin Magana 7:7
content: 7 Sai na gani a cikin marasa azanci, na lura a cikin samari, wani matashi wanda ba shi da hankali.

title: Karin Magana 7:8
content: 8 Yana gangarawa a titi kusa da kusurwarta, yana tafiya a gefen wajen gidanta

title: Karin Magana 7:9
content: 9 da magariba, yayinda rana tana fāɗuwa, yayinda duhun dare yana farawa.

title: Karin Magana 7:10
content: 10 Sai ga mace ta fito don ta sadu da shi, saye da riga kamar karuwa shirye kuma don ta yaudare shi.

title: Karin Magana 7:11
content: 11 (Ba ta jin tsoro, ko kuma kunya, ƙafafunta ba sa zama a gida;

title: Karin Magana 7:12
content: 12 wani lokaci a titi, wani lokaci a dandali, tana yawo a kowace kusurwa.)

title: Karin Magana 7:13
content: 13 Sai ta kama shi ta rungume shi da duban soyayya a fuskarta ta ce,

title: Karin Magana 7:14
content: 14 “Ina da hadaya ta salama a gida; yau zan cika alkawarina.

title: Karin Magana 7:15
content: 15 Saboda haka na fito don in sadu da kai; na neme ka na kuma same ka!

title: Karin Magana 7:16
content: 16 Na lulluɓe gadona da lili masu launi dabam-dabam daga Masar.

title: Karin Magana 7:17
content: 17 Na yayyafa turare a gadona da mur, aloyes da kuma kirfa.

title: Karin Magana 7:18
content: 18 Zo, mu sha zurfin ƙauna har safe; bari mu ji wa ranmu daɗi da ƙauna!

title: Karin Magana 7:19
content: 19 Mijina ba ya gida; ya yi tafiya mai nisa.

title: Karin Magana 7:20
content: 20 Ya ɗauki jakarsa cike da kuɗi ba zai kuwa dawo gida ba sai tsakiyar wata.”

title: Karin Magana 7:21
content: 21 Da kalmomin rarrashi ta sa ya kauce; ta ɗauki hankalinsa da sulɓin maganarta.

title: Karin Magana 7:22
content: 22 Nan take, ya bi ta kamar saniyar da za a kai mayanka, kamar wawa zuwa wurin da za a ba shi horo

title: Karin Magana 7:23
content: 23 sai da kibiya ta soki hantarsa, kamar tsuntsun da ya ruga cikin tarko, ba tare da sani zai zama sanadin ransa ba.

title: Karin Magana 7:24
content: 24 Yanzu fa, ’ya’yana, ku saurare ni; ku kasa kunne ga abin da nake faɗa.

title: Karin Magana 7:25
content: 25 Kada ku bar zuciyarku ta juya zuwa hanyoyinta ko ku kauce zuwa hanyoyinta.

title: Karin Magana 7:26
content: 26 Ta zama sanadin fāɗuwar yawanci; kisan da ta yi ba ta ƙidayuwa.

title: Karin Magana 7:27
content: 27 Gidanta babbar hanya ce zuwa kabari mai yin jagora zuwa ɗakunan lahira.

title: Karin Magana 8:1
content: 1 Hikima ba ta yin kira ne? Fahimi ba ya tā da muryarsa ne?

title: Karin Magana 8:2
content: 2 A ƙwanƙoli a kan hanya, inda hanyoyi suka haɗu, ta ɗauki matsayinta;

title: Karin Magana 8:3
content: 3 kusa da ƙofofin shiga cikin birni, a mashigai, ta tā da murya,

title: Karin Magana 8:4
content: 4 “Gare ku, ya mutane, nake kira; na tā da muryata ga dukan ’yan adam.

title: Karin Magana 8:5
content: 5 Ku da kuke marasa azanci, ku yi hankali; ku da kuke wawaye, ku nemi fahimi.

title: Karin Magana 8:6
content: 6 Ku saurara, gama ina da abubuwa masu darajan da zan faɗa; na buɗe leɓunana don in faɗa abin da yake daidai.

title: Karin Magana 8:7
content: 7 Bakina yana magana abin da yake gaskiya, gama leɓunana sun ƙi mugunta.

title: Karin Magana 8:8
content: 8 Dukan kalmomin bakina suna da adalci; babu waninsu da ya karkace ko kuwa ƙarya ne.

title: Karin Magana 8:9
content: 9 Ga mai tunani dukansu daidai ne; ba su da laifi ga waɗanda suke da sani.

title: Karin Magana 8:10
content: 10 Ku zaɓi umarnina a maimakon azurfa, sani a maimakon zinariya zalla,

title: Karin Magana 8:11
content: 11 gama hikima ta fi lu’ulu’ai daraja, kuma ba abin da kake sha’awa da za a kwatanta da ita.

title: Karin Magana 8:12
content: 12 “Ni, hikima, ina zama tare da hankali; ina da sani da iya rarrabewa.

title: Karin Magana 8:13
content: 13 Jin tsoron Ubangiji shi ne ƙin mugunta; ina ƙin girman kai da fariya, halin mugunta da kuma muguwar magana.

title: Karin Magana 8:14
content: 14 Shawara da yin tunani mai kyau nawa ne; ina da fahimi da kuma iko.

title: Karin Magana 8:15
content: 15 Ta wurina sarakuna suke mulki masu mulki kuma suke yin dokokin da suke da adalci;

title: Karin Magana 8:16
content: 16 ta wurina sarakuna suke mulki, da kuma dukan manyan mutanen da suke mulkin duniya.

title: Karin Magana 8:17
content: 17 Ina ƙaunar waɗanda suke ƙaunata, kuma waɗanda suke nemana sukan same ni.

title: Karin Magana 8:18
content: 18 Tare da ni akwai wadata da girmamawa, dukiya da wadata masu dawwama.

title: Karin Magana 8:19
content: 19 ’Ya’yan itacena sun fi zinariya zalla; amfanin gonar da nake bayar ya fi azurfa mafi kyau.

title: Karin Magana 8:20
content: 20 Ina tafiya a hanyar adalci, a kan hanyoyin gaskiya,

title: Karin Magana 8:21
content: 21 ina ba da wadata ga waɗanda suke ƙaunata ina sa wuraren ajiyarsu su cika.

title: Karin Magana 8:22
content: 22 “Ubangiji ya kawo ni a matsayi na farko na ayyukansa, kafin ayyukansa na tuntuni;

title: Karin Magana 8:23
content: 23 an naɗa ni tun fil azal, daga farko, kafin duniya ta kasance.

title: Karin Magana 8:24
content: 24 Sa’ad da babu tekuna, aka haife ni, sa’ad da babu maɓulɓulai masu ruwa;

title: Karin Magana 8:25
content: 25 kafin a kafa duwatsu a wurarensu, kafin tuddai ma, an haife ni,

title: Karin Magana 8:26
content: 26 kafin ya yi duniya ko gonaki ko wata ƙurar duniya.

title: Karin Magana 8:27
content: 27 Ina nan sa’ad da ya kafa sammai a wurarensu, sa’ad da ya shata sararin sama a kan fuskar zurfafa,

title: Karin Magana 8:28
content: 28 sa’ad da ya kafa gizagizai a bisa ya kuma kafa maɓulɓulan zurfafa daram,

title: Karin Magana 8:29
content: 29 sa’ad da ya ba wa teku iyakarsa domin kada ruwaye su zarce umarninsa, da kuma sa’ad da ya shata tussan duniya.

title: Karin Magana 8:30
content: 30 A lokacin ni ne mai tsara abubuwa a gefensa. Na cika da murna kowace rana, kullum ina farin ciki a gabansa,

title: Karin Magana 8:31
content: 31 ina farin ciki da dukan duniyarsa ina murna da ’yan adam.

title: Karin Magana 8:32
content: 32 “Yanzu fa, ’ya’yana, ku saurare ni; masu albarka ne waɗanda suke kiyaye hanyoyina.

title: Karin Magana 8:33
content: 33 Ku saurari umarnina ku kuma zama masu hikima; kada ku ƙyale ta.

title: Karin Magana 8:34
content: 34 Mai albarka ne wanda ya saurare ni; yana tsaro kullum a ƙofofina, yana jira a ƙofar shigata.

title: Karin Magana 8:35
content: 35 Gama duk wanda ya same ni ya sami rai zai kuma sami tagomashi daga Ubangiji.

title: Karin Magana 8:36
content: 36 Amma duk wanda ya kāsa samuna ya cuci kansa; dukan waɗanda suke ƙina suna ƙaunar mutuwa ke nan.”

title: Karin Magana 9:1
content: 1 Hikima ta gina gidanta; ta yi ginshiƙansa bakwai.

title: Karin Magana 9:2
content: 2 Ta shirya abincinta gauraye da ruwan inabinta; ta kuma shirya teburinta.

title: Karin Magana 9:3
content: 3 Ta aiki bayinta mata, tana kuma kira daga wurare masu tsayi na birnin.

title: Karin Magana 9:4
content: 4 “Bari dukan waɗanda suke marasa azanci su zo nan ciki!” Tana faɗa wa marasa hankali.

title: Karin Magana 9:5
content: 5 “Ku zo, ku ci abincina da ruwan inabin da na gauraye.

title: Karin Magana 9:6
content: 6 Ku bar hanyoyinku marasa hankali za ku kuwa rayu; yi tafiya a hanyar fahimi.

title: Karin Magana 9:7
content: 7 “Duk wanda ya yi wa mai ba’a gyara yana gayyatar zagi duk wanda ya tsawata wa mugu yakan gamu da cin mutunci.

title: Karin Magana 9:8
content: 8 Kada ka tsawata wa masu ba’a gama za su ƙi ka; ka tsawata wa mai hikima zai kuwa ƙaunace ka.

title: Karin Magana 9:9
content: 9 Ka koya wa mai hikima zai kuwa ƙara hikima; ka koya wa mai adalci zai kuwa ƙara koyonsa.

title: Karin Magana 9:10
content: 10 “Tsoron Ubangiji shi ne mafarin hikima, sanin Mai Tsarki kuwa fahimi ne.

title: Karin Magana 9:11
content: 11 Gama ta wurina kwanakinka za su yi yawa, za a kuwa ƙara wa ranka shekaru.

title: Karin Magana 9:12
content: 12 In kana da hikima, hikimarka za tă ba ka lada; in kai mai ba’a ne, kai kaɗai za ka sha wahala.”

title: Karin Magana 9:13
content: 13 Wawancin mace a bayyane yake; ba ta da ɗa’a kuma ba ta da sani.

title: Karin Magana 9:14
content: 14 Takan zauna a ƙofar gidanta, a wurin zama a wurin mafi tsayi na birni,

title: Karin Magana 9:15
content: 15 tana kira ga masu wucewa, waɗanda suke tafiya kai tsaye a hanyarsu.

title: Karin Magana 9:16
content: 16 “Bari dukan waɗanda suke marasa azanci su zo cikin nan!” Tana ce wa marasa hankali.

title: Karin Magana 9:17
content: 17 “Ruwan da aka sata ya fi daɗi; abincin da aka ci a ɓoye ya fi daɗi!”

title: Karin Magana 9:18
content: 18 Amma ba su san cewa matattu suna a can ba, cewa baƙinta suna a can cikin zurfin kabari ba.

title: Karin Magana 10:1
content: 1 Karin maganar Solomon. Ɗa mai hikima yakan kawo wa mahaifinsa farin ciki, amma wawan ɗa kan sa wa mahaifiyarsa baƙin ciki.

title: Karin Magana 10:2
content: 2 Dukiyar da aka samu a hanyar da ba tă dace ba, ba ta da albarka, amma adalci kan ceci mutum daga mutuwa.

title: Karin Magana 10:3
content: 3 Ubangiji ba ya barin mai adalci da yunwa amma yakan lalace burin mugu.

title: Karin Magana 10:4
content: 4 Ragwanci kan sa mutum yă zama matalauci, amma aiki tuƙuru kan ba da dukiya.

title: Karin Magana 10:5
content: 5 Shi da ya tattara hatsi da rani ɗa ne mai hikima, amma shi da yakan yi barci a lokacin girbi ɗa ne wanda ya zama abin kunya.

title: Karin Magana 10:6
content: 6 Albarka kan zauna a kan mai adalci kamar rawani, amma rikici kan sha bakin mugu.

title: Karin Magana 10:7
content: 7 Tunawa da mai adalci albarka ne amma sunan mugu zai ruɓe.

title: Karin Magana 10:8
content: 8 Mai hikima a zuciya yakan yarda da umarni amma surutun wawa kan kai ga lalaci.

title: Karin Magana 10:9
content: 9 Mai mutunci yana tafiya lafiya, amma shi da yake tafiya a karkatattun hanyoyi za a kama shi.

title: Karin Magana 10:10
content: 10 Shi da ya ƙyifta ido da mugunta kan jawo baƙin ciki surutun wawa kuma kan zo da lalaci.

title: Karin Magana 10:11
content: 11 Bakin adali maɓulɓulan rai ne, amma kalmar mugun takan ɓoye makircinsa.

title: Karin Magana 10:12
content: 12 Ƙiyayya kan haddasa wahala, amma ƙauna kan rufe dukan laifofi.

title: Karin Magana 10:13
content: 13 Ana samun hikima a leɓunan masu fahimi, amma bulala domin bayan marasa azanci ne.

title: Karin Magana 10:14
content: 14 Mai hikima kan yi ajiyar sani, amma bakin wawa kan gayyaci lalaci.

title: Karin Magana 10:15
content: 15 Dukiyar masu arziki yakan zama mafakar birninsu, amma talauci shi ne lalacin matalauci.

title: Karin Magana 10:16
content: 16 Hakkin adalai kan kawo musu rai, amma albashin mugaye kan kawo musu hukunci.

title: Karin Magana 10:17
content: 17 Duk wanda ya mai da hankali ga horo kan nuna hanyar rai, amma duk wanda ya ƙyale gyara kan sa waɗansu su kauce.

title: Karin Magana 10:18
content: 18 Duk wanda ya ɓoye ƙiyayyarsa yana da ƙarya a leɓunansa, duk kuma wanda yake baza ƙarairayi wawa ne.

title: Karin Magana 10:19
content: 19 Sa’ad da magana ta yi yawa, ba a rasa zunubi a ciki, amma shi da ya ƙame harshensa mai hikima ne.

title: Karin Magana 10:20
content: 20 Harshen adali azurfa ce zalla, amma zuciyar mugu ba ta da wani amfani.

title: Karin Magana 10:21
content: 21 Leɓunan adalai kan amfane yawanci, amma wawa kan mutu saboda rashin azanci.

title: Karin Magana 10:22
content: 22 Albarkar Ubangiji kan kawo wadata, ba ya kuma ƙara wahala a kai.

title: Karin Magana 10:23
content: 23 Wawa yakan ji daɗi halin mugunta, amma mutum mai fahimi kan ji daɗin hikima.

title: Karin Magana 10:24
content: 24 Abin da mugu ke tsoro shi ne zai same shi; abin da adali ke bukata yakan sami biyan bukata.

title: Karin Magana 10:25
content: 25 Sa’ad da hadiri ya taso, yakan watsar da mugaye, amma adalai za su tsaya daram har abada.

title: Karin Magana 10:26
content: 26 Kamar yadda ruwan tsami yake ga haƙora hayaƙi kuma ga idanu, haka malalaci yake ga wanda ya aike shi.

title: Karin Magana 10:27
content: 27 Tsoron Ubangiji kan ƙara tsawon rai, amma akan gajartar da shekarun mugaye.

title: Karin Magana 10:28
content: 28 Abin da adali yake sa rai yakan kai ga farin ciki, amma sa zuciyar mugu ba ya haifar da kome.

title: Karin Magana 10:29
content: 29 Hanyar Ubangiji mafaka ce ga adalai amma lalaci ne ga waɗanda suke aikata mugunta.

title: Karin Magana 10:30
content: 30 Ba za a taɓa tumɓuke masu adalci ba, amma mugaye ba za su ci gaba da kasance a ƙasar ba.

title: Karin Magana 10:31
content: 31 Bakin adalai kan fitar da hikima, amma za a dakatar da mugun harshe.

title: Karin Magana 10:32
content: 32 Leɓunan adalai sun san abin da ya dace, amma bakunan mugaye sun san abin da yake mugu ne kawai.

title: Karin Magana 11:1
content: 1 Ubangiji yana ƙyamar ma’aunan zamba, amma ma’aunin da suke daidai ne abin farin cikinsa.

title: Karin Magana 11:2
content: 2 Sa’ad da girman kai ya zo, sai shan kunya ta zo, amma hikima kan zo tare da ƙasƙantar da kai.

title: Karin Magana 11:3
content: 3 Mutuncin masu aikata gaskiya takan bi da su, amma marasa aminci sukan hallaka ta wurin cin amanar da suke yi.

title: Karin Magana 11:4
content: 4 Dukiya ba ta da amfani a ranar fushi, amma adalci kan yi ceto daga mutuwa.

title: Karin Magana 11:5
content: 5 Adalcin marasa laifi kan miƙe hanyarsu, amma akan ƙasƙantar da mugaye ta wurin muguntarsu.

title: Karin Magana 11:6
content: 6 Adalcin masu aikata gaskiya kan cece su, amma rashin aminci tarko ne ga mugayen sha’awace-sha’awace.

title: Karin Magana 11:7
content: 7 Sa’ad da mugu ya mutu, sa zuciyarsa kan hallaka; dukan abin da ya sa zuciya daga ikonsa ba ya amfana kome.

title: Karin Magana 11:8
content: 8 Akan kuɓutar da mai adalci daga wahala, sai ta dawo wa mugu a maimako.

title: Karin Magana 11:9
content: 9 Da bakinsa marar sanin Allah kan hallaka maƙwabcinsa, amma ta wurin sani mai adalci kan kuɓuta.

title: Karin Magana 11:10
content: 10 Sa’ad da adali ya yi nasara, birnin kan yi farin ciki; sa’ad da mugu ya hallaka, akwai sowa ta farin ciki.

title: Karin Magana 11:11
content: 11 Ta wurin albarkar mai aikata gaskiya birni kan ƙasaita, amma ta wurin bakin mugu akan hallaka birnin.

title: Karin Magana 11:12
content: 12 Mutum da ba shi da azanci kan ki maƙwabci, amma mutum mai fahimi kan ƙame harshensa.

title: Karin Magana 11:13
content: 13 Gulma yakan lalace yarda, amma mutum mai aminci kan kiyaye asiri.

title: Karin Magana 11:14
content: 14 Saboda rashin jagora al’umma takan fāɗi, amma masu ba da shawara da yawa kan tabbatar da nasara.

title: Karin Magana 11:15
content: 15 Duk wanda ya ɗauki lamunin wani tabbatacce zai sha wahala, amma duk wanda ya ƙi ya sa hannu a ɗaukar lamuni ba ruwansa.

title: Karin Magana 11:16
content: 16 Mace mai hankali na samu bangirma, amma azzalumai za su sami dukiya.

title: Karin Magana 11:17
content: 17 Mutumin kirki kan ribance kansa, amma mugu kan kawo wa kansa wahala.

title: Karin Magana 11:18
content: 18 Mugun mutum kan sami albashin ƙarya amma shi da ya shuka adalci zai girbe lada tabbatacce.

title: Karin Magana 11:19
content: 19 Mutum mai adalci da gaske yakan sami rai, amma shi da ya duƙufa ga aikata mugunta kan tarar da mutuwarsa.

title: Karin Magana 11:20
content: 20 Ubangiji yana ƙyamar mutane masu muguwar zuciya amma yana jin daɗin waɗanda hanyoyinsu ba su da laifi.

title: Karin Magana 11:21
content: 21 Ka tabbata da wannan. Mugaye ba za su tafi babu hukunci ba, amma waɗanda suke masu adalci za su tafi babu hukunci.

title: Karin Magana 11:22
content: 22 Kamar zinariya a hancin alade haka kyan mace wadda ba ta da hankali.

title: Karin Magana 11:23
content: 23 Sha’awar adalai kan ƙare kawai a aikata alheri, amma sa zuciyar mugaye kan ƙarasa kawai a fushi.

title: Karin Magana 11:24
content: 24 Wani mutum kan bayar hannu sake, duk da haka yakan sami fiye; wani yakan riƙe abin da ba nasa ba, amma sai ya ƙarasa cikin talauci.

title: Karin Magana 11:25
content: 25 Mutum mai kyauta zai azurta; shi da yakan taimake waɗansu, za a taimake shi.

title: Karin Magana 11:26
content: 26 Mutane kan la’anci mai ɓoye hatsi yana jira ya yi tsada, amma albarka kan zauna a kan wanda yake niyya ya sayar.

title: Karin Magana 11:27
content: 27 Duk mai nema alheri kan sami alheri, amma mugu kan zo wa wanda yake nemansa.

title: Karin Magana 11:28
content: 28 Duk wanda ya dogara ga arzikinsa zai fāɗi, amma adali zai yi nasara kamar koren ganye.

title: Karin Magana 11:29
content: 29 Duk wanda ya kawo wahala wa iyalinsa zai gāji iska kawai, kuma wawa zai zama bawan masu hikima.

title: Karin Magana 11:30
content: 30 ’Ya’yan itacen adali itacen rai ne, kuma duk mai samun rayuka mai hikima ne.

title: Karin Magana 11:31
content: 31 In masu adalci sun sami abin da ya dace da su a duniya, yaya zai zama ga marasa sanin Allah da kuma masu zunubi!

title: Karin Magana 12:1
content: 1 Duk mai ƙaunar horo yana ƙaunar sani, amma duk mai ƙin gyara wawa ne.

title: Karin Magana 12:2
content: 2 Mutumin kirki kan sami tagomashi daga Ubangiji, amma Ubangiji yakan hukunta mai son yin wayo.

title: Karin Magana 12:3
content: 3 Ba yadda mutum zai kahu ta wurin aikata mugunta, amma ba za a tumɓuke adali ba.

title: Karin Magana 12:4
content: 4 Mace mai halin kirki rawanin mijinta ne, amma mace marar kunya tana kama da ciwo a ƙasusuwansa.

title: Karin Magana 12:5
content: 5 Shirye-shiryen masu adalci daidai ne, amma shawarar mugaye ruɗu ne.

title: Karin Magana 12:6
content: 6 Kalmomin mugu sukan kwanta suna jira su yi kisankai, amma jawabin masu aikata gaskiya kan kuɓutar da su.

title: Karin Magana 12:7
content: 7 Akan tumɓuke mugaye ba a ƙara ganinsu, amma gidan masu adalci kan tsaya daram.

title: Karin Magana 12:8
content: 8 Akan yabi mutum bisa ga hikimarsa, amma mutane marasa azanci akan rena su.

title: Karin Magana 12:9
content: 9 Gara ka zama kai ba kome ba ne amma kana da bawa da ka mai da kanka kai wani ne alhali kuwa ba ka da abinci.

title: Karin Magana 12:10
content: 10 Mai adalci kan kula da bukatun dabbobinsa, amma halaye mafi kyau na mugaye su ne ƙeta.

title: Karin Magana 12:11
content: 11 Duk wanda ya nome gonarsa zai sami abinci a yalwace, amma shi da yake naushin iska marar azanci ne.

title: Karin Magana 12:12
content: 12 Mugaye suna sha’awar ganimar mugayen mutane, amma saiwar masu adalci kan haɓaka.

title: Karin Magana 12:13
content: 13 Mugun mutum kan fāɗa a tarkon maganarsa ta zunubi, amma adali kan kuɓuta daga wahala.

title: Karin Magana 12:14
content: 14 Daga abubuwan da suke fitowa daga leɓunansa mutum kan cika da abubuwa masu kyau tabbatacce yadda aikin hannuwansa suke ba shi lada.

title: Karin Magana 12:15
content: 15 Hanyar wawa daidai take a gare shi, amma mai hikima kan saurari shawara.

title: Karin Magana 12:16
content: 16 Wawa kan nuna fushinsa nan take, amma mai la’akari kan ƙyale zargi.

title: Karin Magana 12:17
content: 17 Mashaidin gaskiya kan ba da shaidar gaskiya, amma mashaidin ƙarya yana baza ƙarairayi ne.

title: Karin Magana 12:18
content: 18 Maganganun rashin tunani sukan soki mutum kamar takobi, amma harshen mai hikima kan kawo warkarwa.

title: Karin Magana 12:19
content: 19 Leɓunan gaskiya kan dawwama har abada, amma harshen ƙarya yakan dawwama na ɗan lokaci ne kawai.

title: Karin Magana 12:20
content: 20 Akwai ruɗu a zukatan waɗanda suke ƙulla mugunta, amma waɗanda suke aikata alheri za su yi farin ciki.

title: Karin Magana 12:21
content: 21 Ba wani lahanin da zai sami masu adalci, amma mugaye suna da nasu cike da wahala.

title: Karin Magana 12:22
content: 22 Ubangiji yana ƙyamar leɓunan masu ƙarya, amma yana jin daɗin mutanen da suke masu gaskiya.

title: Karin Magana 12:23
content: 23 Mai la’akari kan kiyaye saninsa wa kansa, amma zuciyar wawa kan yi ta tallar wawanci.

title: Karin Magana 12:24
content: 24 Hannuwan masu aiki tuƙuru za su yi mulki, amma ragwanci kan ƙarasa a aikin bauta.

title: Karin Magana 12:25
content: 25 Zuciya mai damuwa takan naƙasar da mutum, amma maganar alheri kan faranta masa rai.

title: Karin Magana 12:26
content: 26 Adali yakan yi hankali a abokantaka, amma hanyar mugaye kan kai su ga kaucewa.

title: Karin Magana 12:27
content: 27 Rago ba ya gashin abin da ya kama daga farauta, amma mai aiki tuƙuru yakan ɗauki mallakarsa da muhimmanci.

title: Karin Magana 12:28
content: 28 A hanyar adalci akwai rai; a wannan hanya akwai rashin mutuwa.

title: Karin Magana 13:1
content: 1 Ɗa mai hikima yakan mai da hankali ga umarnin mahaifinsa, amma mai ba’a ba ya sauraran kwaɓi.

title: Karin Magana 13:2
content: 2 Daga abin da ya fito leɓunan mutum ne mutum kan ji daɗin abubuwa masu kyau, amma marar aminci yakan ƙosa ya tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye.

title: Karin Magana 13:3
content: 3 Duk mai lura da leɓunansa yakan lura da ransa, amma duk mai magana da haushi zai kai ga lalaci.

title: Karin Magana 13:4
content: 4 Rago ya ƙosa ya sami wani abu ainun amma ba ya samun kome, amma sha’awar mai aiki tuƙuru yakan ƙoshi sosai.

title: Karin Magana 13:5
content: 5 Adali yana ƙin abin da yake ƙarya, amma mugu kan jawo kunya da ƙasƙanci.

title: Karin Magana 13:6
content: 6 Adalci yakan lura da mutum mai mutunci, amma mugunta takan sha kan mai zunubi.

title: Karin Magana 13:7
content: 7 Wani mutum yakan ɗauki kansa mai arziki ne, alhali ba shi da kome, wani ya ɗauki kansa shi matalauci ne, alhali shi mawadaci ne ƙwarai.

title: Karin Magana 13:8
content: 8 Arzikin mutum zai iya kuɓutar da ransa, amma matalauci ba ya jin barazana.

title: Karin Magana 13:9
content: 9 Hasken masu adalci kan haskaka ƙwarai, amma fitilar mugaye mutuwa take.

title: Karin Magana 13:10
content: 10 Girmankai kan jawo faɗa ne kawai, amma hikima tana samuwa a waɗanda suke jin shawara.

title: Karin Magana 13:11
content: 11 Kuɗin da aka same su a rashin gaskiya yakan ɓace da sauri, amma duk wanda ya tara kuɗi kaɗan-kaɗan za su yi ta ƙaruwa.

title: Karin Magana 13:12
content: 12 Sa zuciyar da aka ɗaga zuwa gaba kan sa zuciya tă yi ciwo, amma marmarin da aka ƙosar yana kamar itacen rai.

title: Karin Magana 13:13
content: 13 Duk wanda ya rena umarni zai ɗanɗana ƙodarsa, amma duk wanda ya yi biyayya da umarni zai sami lada.

title: Karin Magana 13:14
content: 14 Koyarwar mai hikima maɓulɓulan rai ne, mai juyar da mutum daga tarkon mutuwa.

title: Karin Magana 13:15
content: 15 Fahimta mai kyau kan sami tagomashi, amma hanyar marar aminci tana da wuya.

title: Karin Magana 13:16
content: 16 Kowane mai azanci yakan nuna sani, amma wawa yakan yi tallen wawancinsa.

title: Karin Magana 13:17
content: 17 Mugun ɗan saƙo kan shiga wahala, amma jakadan da mai aminci yakan kawo warkarwa.

title: Karin Magana 13:18
content: 18 Duk wanda ya ƙyale horo yakan kai ga talauci da kuma kunya, amma duk wanda ya karɓi gyara yakan sami girma.

title: Karin Magana 13:19
content: 19 Marmarin da aka cika yana da daɗi ga rai, amma wawa yana ƙyamar juyewa daga mugunta.

title: Karin Magana 13:20
content: 20 Shi da yake tafiya tare da masu hikima yakan ƙaru da hikima, amma abokin wawaye zai yi fama da lahani.

title: Karin Magana 13:21
content: 21 Rashin sa’a kan fafare mai zunubi, amma wadata ce ladar adali.

title: Karin Magana 13:22
content: 22 Mutumin kirki kan bar gādo wa ’ya’ya ’ya’yansa, amma arzikin mai zunubi ajiye ne da aka yi wa mai adalci.

title: Karin Magana 13:23
content: 23 Gonar matalauci za tă iya ba da abinci a yalwace, amma rashin adalci kan share shi tas.

title: Karin Magana 13:24
content: 24 Duk wanda ba ya horon ɗansa ba ƙaunarsa yake yi ba, amma duk mai ƙaunarsa yakan kula ya hore shi.

title: Karin Magana 13:25
content: 25 Masu adalci sukan ci isashen abinci, amma cikin mugaye na fama da yunwa.

title: Karin Magana 14:1
content: 1 Mace mai hikima kan gina gidanta, amma da hannunta wawiya takan rushe shi ƙasa.

title: Karin Magana 14:2
content: 2 Wanda tafiyarsa ta aikata gaskiya ce kan ji tsoron Ubangiji, amma wanda hanyoyinsa ba a kan gaskiya ba ne yakan rena shi.

title: Karin Magana 14:3
content: 3 Maganar wawa kan kawo sanda a bayansa, amma leɓunan masu hikima kan tsare su.

title: Karin Magana 14:4
content: 4 Inda ba shanu, wurin sa wa dabbobi abinci zai kasance ba kome, amma daga ƙarfin saniya ce yalwar girbi kan fito.

title: Karin Magana 14:5
content: 5 Mashaidi na gaskiya ba ya ruɗu, amma mashaidin ƙarya kan baza ƙarairayi.

title: Karin Magana 14:6
content: 6 Mai ba’a kan nemi hikima amma ba ya samun kome, amma sani kan zo a sawwaƙe ga mai basira.

title: Karin Magana 14:7
content: 7 Ka guji wawa, gama ba za ka sami sani a leɓunansa ba.

title: Karin Magana 14:8
content: 8 Hikima masu la’akari shi ne su yi tunani a kan hanyoyinsu, amma wautar wawaye ruɗu ne.

title: Karin Magana 14:9
content: 9 Wawaye kan yi ba’a a gyaran zunubi, amma fatan alheri yana samuwa a cikin masu aikata gaskiya.

title: Karin Magana 14:10
content: 10 Kowace zuciya ta san ɓacin ranta, kuma babu wani dabam da zai yi rabon jin daɗinsa.

title: Karin Magana 14:11
content: 11 Za a rushe gidan mugu, amma tentin mai aikata gaskiya zai haɓaka.

title: Karin Magana 14:12
content: 12 Akwai hanyar da ta yi kamar tana daidai ga mutum, amma a ƙarshe takan kai ga mutuwa.

title: Karin Magana 14:13
content: 13 Ko cikin dariya zuciya takan yi ciwo, kuma farin ciki kan iya ƙarasa a baƙin ciki.

title: Karin Magana 14:14
content: 14 Marasa bangaskiya za su sami sakamako cikakke saboda hanyoyinsu, kuma mutumin kirki zai sami lada saboda nasa.

title: Karin Magana 14:15
content: 15 Marar azanci kan gaskata kome, amma mai la’akari kan yi tunani game da matakinsa.

title: Karin Magana 14:16
content: 16 Mai hikima kan ji tsoron Ubangiji ya kuma guji mugunta, amma wawa yana da girman kai yakan yi kome da garaje.

title: Karin Magana 14:17
content: 17 Mutum mai saurin fushi yakan yi ayyukan wauta, akan kuma ƙi mai son nuna wayo.

title: Karin Magana 14:18
content: 18 Marar azanci kan gāji wauta, amma mai la’akari kan sami rawanin sani.

title: Karin Magana 14:19
content: 19 Masu mugunta za su rusuna a gaban masu kirki, mugaye kuma za su yi haka a ƙofofin adalai.

title: Karin Magana 14:20
content: 20 Maƙwabta sukan gudu daga matalauta, amma masu arziki suna da abokai da yawa.

title: Karin Magana 14:21
content: 21 Duk wanda ya rena maƙwabci ya yi zunubi, amma mai albarka ne wanda yake alheri ga mabukata.

title: Karin Magana 14:22
content: 22 Ba waɗanda suke ƙulla mugunta sukan kauce ba? Amma waɗanda suke ƙulla abin da yake mai kyau sukan sami ƙauna da aminci.

title: Karin Magana 14:23
content: 23 Duk aiki tuƙuru yakan kawo riba, amma zama kana surutu kan kai ga talauci kawai.

title: Karin Magana 14:24
content: 24 Dukiyar masu hikima ita ce rawaninsu, amma wautar wawaye kan haifar da wauta ne kawai.

title: Karin Magana 14:25
content: 25 Mashaidin gaskiya kan ceci rayuka, amma mashaidin ƙarya mai ruɗu ne.

title: Karin Magana 14:26
content: 26 Duk mai tsoron Ubangiji yana da zaunannen mafaka, kuma ga ’ya’yansa zai zama mafaka.

title: Karin Magana 14:27
content: 27 Tsoron Ubangiji shi ne maɓulɓular rai yakan juye mutum daga tarkon mutuwa.

title: Karin Magana 14:28
content: 28 Yawan mutane shi ne ɗaukakar sarki, amma in ba tare da mabiya ba sarki ba kome ba ne.

title: Karin Magana 14:29
content: 29 Mutum mai haƙuri yana da fahimi mai yawa, amma mai saurin fushi yakan nuna wautarsa a fili.

title: Karin Magana 14:30
content: 30 Zuciya mai salama kan ba jiki rai, amma kishi kan sa ƙasusuwa su yi ciwo.

title: Karin Magana 14:31
content: 31 Duk wanda ya zalunci matalauci ya zagi Mahaliccinsu ke nan, amma duk wanda ya yi alheri ga mabukata yana girmama Allah ne.

title: Karin Magana 14:32
content: 32 Sa’ad bala’i ya auku, mugaye kan fāɗi, amma ko a mutuwa masu adalci suna da mafaka.

title: Karin Magana 14:33
content: 33 Hikima tana a zuciyar mai azanci, kuma ko a cikin wawaye takan sa a santa.

title: Karin Magana 14:34
content: 34 Adalci yakan ɗaukaka al’umma, amma zunubi kan kawo kunya ga kowane mutane.

title: Karin Magana 14:35
content: 35 Sarki yakan yi murna a kan bawa mai hikima, amma bawa marar kunya kan jawo fushinsa.

title: Karin Magana 15:1
content: 1 Amsa da tattausar harshe kan kwantar da fushi, amma magana da kakkausan harshe kan kuta fushi.

title: Karin Magana 15:2
content: 2 Harshen mai hikima kan yi zance mai kyau a kan sani, amma bakin wawa kan fitar da wauta.

title: Karin Magana 15:3
content: 3 Idanun Ubangiji suna a ko’ina, suna lura da masu aikata mugunta da masu aikata alheri.

title: Karin Magana 15:4
content: 4 Harshen da ya kawo warkarwa shi ne itacen rai, amma harshe mai ƙarya kan ragargaza zuciya.

title: Karin Magana 15:5
content: 5 Wawa yakan ƙi kulawa da horon da mahaifinsa yake masa, amma duk wanda ya yarda da gyara kan nuna azanci.

title: Karin Magana 15:6
content: 6 Gidan adali yana da dukiya mai yawa, amma albashin mugaye kan kawo musu wahala.

title: Karin Magana 15:7
content: 7 Leɓunan masu hikima sukan baza sani; ba haka zukatan wawaye suke ba.

title: Karin Magana 15:8
content: 8 Ubangiji yana ƙyamar hadayar mugaye, amma addu’ar masu aikata gaskiya kan sa ya ji daɗi.

title: Karin Magana 15:9
content: 9 Ubangiji yana ƙin hanyar mugaye amma yana ƙaunar waɗanda suke neman adalci.

title: Karin Magana 15:10
content: 10 Horo mai tsanani yana jiran duk wanda ya bar hanya; wanda ya ƙi gyara zai mutu.

title: Karin Magana 15:11
content: 11 Mutuwa da Hallaka suna nan a fili a gaban Ubangiji, balle fa zukatan mutane!

title: Karin Magana 15:12
content: 12 Mai yin ba’a yakan ƙi gyara; ba zai nemi shawara mai hikima ba.

title: Karin Magana 15:13
content: 13 Zuciya mai farin ciki kan sa fuska tă yi haske, amma ciwon zuciya kan ragargaza rai.

title: Karin Magana 15:14
content: 14 Zuciya mai la’akari kan nemi sani, amma bakin wawa wauta ce ke ciyar da shi.

title: Karin Magana 15:15
content: 15 Dukan kwanakin mutumin da ake danniya fama yake yi, amma zuciya mai farin ciki yana yin biki kullum.

title: Karin Magana 15:16
content: 16 Gara a kasance da kaɗan da tsoron Ubangiji da a kasance da arziki mai yawa game da wahala.

title: Karin Magana 15:17
content: 17 Gara a ci abincin kayan ganye inda akwai ƙauna da a ci kiwotaccen saniya inda ƙiyayya take.

title: Karin Magana 15:18
content: 18 Mutum mai zafin rai kan kawo faɗa, amma mutum mai haƙuri kan kwantar da faɗa.

title: Karin Magana 15:19
content: 19 An tare hanyar rago da ƙayayyuwa, amma hanyar mai aikata gaskiya buɗaɗɗiyar hanya ce.

title: Karin Magana 15:20
content: 20 Ɗa mai hikima kan kawo farin ciki wa mahaifinsa, amma wawa yakan rena mahaifiyarsa.

title: Karin Magana 15:21
content: 21 Wauta kan sa mutum marar azanci ya yi farin ciki, amma mai basira kan kiyaye abin da yake yi daidai.

title: Karin Magana 15:22
content: 22 Shirye-shirye sukan lalace saboda rashin neman shawara, amma tare da mashawarta masu yawa za su yi nasara.

title: Karin Magana 15:23
content: 23 Mutum yakan yi farin ciki a ba da amsar da take daidai, kuma ina misali a yi magana a lokacin da ya dace!

title: Karin Magana 15:24
content: 24 Hanyar rai na yin jagora ya haura wa masu hikima don ta kiyaye shi daga gangarawa zuwa kabari.

title: Karin Magana 15:25
content: 25 Ubangiji yakan rushe gidan mai girman kai amma yakan kiyaye iyakokin gwauruwa daidai.

title: Karin Magana 15:26
content: 26 Ubangiji yana ƙyamar tunanin mugaye, amma waɗanda suke da tunani masu tsabta yakan ji daɗinsu.

title: Karin Magana 15:27
content: 27 Mutum mai haɗama kan kawo wahala ga iyalinsa, amma wanda yake ƙin cin hanci zai rayu.

title: Karin Magana 15:28
content: 28 Zuciyar mai adalci takan auna amsoshinta, amma bakin mugu yakan fitar da mugunta.

title: Karin Magana 15:29
content: 29 Ubangiji yana nesa da mugaye amma yakan ji addu’ar adalai.

title: Karin Magana 15:30
content: 30 Fuska mai fara’a takan kawo farin ciki ga zuciya, kuma labari mai daɗi na kawo lafiya ga ƙasusuwa.

title: Karin Magana 15:31
content: 31 Duk wanda ya mai da hankali sa’ad da ake tsawata masa ba zai kasance dabam a cikin masu hikima ba.

title: Karin Magana 15:32
content: 32 Duk waɗanda suka ƙi horon sun rena kansu ke nan, amma duk waɗanda sun yarda da gyara sukan ƙara basira.

title: Karin Magana 15:33
content: 33 Tsoron Ubangiji yakan koya wa mutum hikima, kuma sauƙinkai kan zo kafin girmamawa.

title: Karin Magana 16:1
content: 1 Ga mutum ne shirye-shiryen zuciya suke, amma daga Ubangiji ne amshin harshe kan zo.

title: Karin Magana 16:2
content: 2 Dukan hanyoyin mutum sukan yi kamar marar laifi ne gare shi, amma Ubangiji yakan auna manufofi.

title: Karin Magana 16:3
content: 3 Ka miƙa wa Ubangiji dukan abin da kake yi, shirye-shiryenka kuwa za su yi nasara.

title: Karin Magana 16:4
content: 4 Ubangiji yana yin kome domin amfaninsa, har ma da mugaye domin ranar masifa.

title: Karin Magana 16:5
content: 5 Ubangiji yana ƙyamar dukan zuciya mai girman kai. Ka tabbata da wannan. Ba za su kuɓuta daga hukunci ba.

title: Karin Magana 16:6
content: 6 Ta wurin ƙauna da aminci akan yi kafarar zunubi; ta wurin tsoron Ubangiji mutum kan guji mugunta.

title: Karin Magana 16:7
content: 7 Sa’ad da hanyoyin mutum sun gamshi Ubangiji, yakan sa abokan gāban mutumin ma su zauna lafiya da shi.

title: Karin Magana 16:8
content: 8 Gara ka sami kaɗan ta hanyar adalci da sami riba mai yawa ta hanyar rashin gaskiya.

title: Karin Magana 16:9
content: 9 ’Yan Adam sukan yi shirye-shiryensu a zukatansu, amma Ubangiji ne yake da ikon cika matakansa.

title: Karin Magana 16:10
content: 10 Leɓunan sarki kan yi magana kamar ta wurin ikon Allah, kuma bai kamata bakinsa ya yi kuskure a yanke shari’a ba.

title: Karin Magana 16:11
content: 11 Ma’aunai da magwajin gaskiya daga Ubangiji ne; dukan ma’aunai da suke cikin jaka yinsa ne.

title: Karin Magana 16:12
content: 12 Sarakuna suna ƙyamar abin da ba shi da kyau, gama an kafa kujerar sarauta ta wurin adalci ne.

title: Karin Magana 16:13
content: 13 Sarakuna sukan ji daɗi leɓuna masu yin gaskiya; sukan darjanta mutumin da yake faɗin gaskiya.

title: Karin Magana 16:14
content: 14 Fushin sarki ɗan saƙon mutuwa ne, amma mai hikima yakan faranta masa rai.

title: Karin Magana 16:15
content: 15 Sa’ad da fuskar sarki ta haska, yana nufin rai ke nan; tagomashinsa yana kamar girgijen ruwa a bazara.

title: Karin Magana 16:16
content: 16 Ya ma fi kyau ka sami hikima fiye da zinariya, ka zaɓi fahimi a maimakon azurfa!

title: Karin Magana 16:17
content: 17 Buɗaɗɗiyar hanyar masu aikata gaskiya kan guje wa mugunta; duk wanda yake lura da hanyarsa yakan lura da ransa.

title: Karin Magana 16:18
content: 18 Girmankai yakan zo kafin hallaka, girman kai yakan zo kafin fāɗuwa.

title: Karin Magana 16:19
content: 19 Gara ka zama ɗaya daga cikin matalauta masu sauƙinkai, da ka raba ganima da masu girman kai.

title: Karin Magana 16:20
content: 20 Duk wanda ya mai da hankali ga umarni yakan yi nasara, kuma mai albarka ne wanda yake dogara ga Ubangiji.

title: Karin Magana 16:21
content: 21 Akan ce da masu hikima a zuciya hazikai, kuma kalmomi masu daɗi kan inganta umarni.

title: Karin Magana 16:22
content: 22 Fahimi shi ne maɓulɓular rai ga waɗanda suke da shi, amma wauta kan kawo hukunci ga wawaye.

title: Karin Magana 16:23
content: 23 Zuciyar mai hikima kan bi da bakinsa, kuma leɓunansa kan inganta umarni.

title: Karin Magana 16:24
content: 24 Kalmomi masu daɗi suna kama da kakin zuma, mai zaƙi ga rai da kuma warkarwa ga ƙasusuwa.

title: Karin Magana 16:25
content: 25 Akwai hanyar da ta yi kamar daidai ga mutum, amma a ƙarshe takan kai ga mutuwa.

title: Karin Magana 16:26
content: 26 Marmarin cin abinci yakan yi wa ɗan ƙodago aiki; yunwarsa kan sa ya ci gaba.

title: Karin Magana 16:27
content: 27 Mutumin banza yakan ƙulla mugunta, kuma jawabinsa yana kama da wuta mai ƙuna.

title: Karin Magana 16:28
content: 28 Fitinannen mutum yakan zuga tashin hankali, mai gulma kuma yakan raba abokai na kusa.

title: Karin Magana 16:29
content: 29 Mutum mai tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye yakan ruɗi maƙwabcinsa ya kai shi a hanyar da ba ta da kyau.

title: Karin Magana 16:30
content: 30 Duk wanda ya ƙyifce da idonsa yana ƙulla maƙarƙashiya ce; duk wanda ya murguɗa leɓunansa yana niyya aikata mugunta ke nan.

title: Karin Magana 16:31
content: 31 Furfura rawani ne mai daraja; akan same ta ta wurin yin rayuwa ta adalci.

title: Karin Magana 16:32
content: 32 Gara ka zama mai haƙuri da ka zama jarumi, ya fi kyau ka iya mallakar kanka fiye da mallakar birane.

title: Karin Magana 16:33
content: 33 Akan jefa ƙuri’a a kan cinya, amma kowace shawara mai kyau daga Ubangiji ne.

title: Karin Magana 17:1
content: 1 Gara ka ci busasshen burodi da kwanciyar rai kuma shiru da ka je cin abinci a gidan da ke cike da biki amma da ɓacin rai.

title: Karin Magana 17:2
content: 2 Bawa mai hikima zai yi mulki a kan da mai rashin kunya, kuma zai raba gādo kamar ɗaya daga cikin ’yan’uwansa.

title: Karin Magana 17:3
content: 3 Ana gwajin azurfa da kuma zinariya da wuta, amma Ubangiji ne mai gwajin zuciya.

title: Karin Magana 17:4
content: 4 Mugun mutum kan mai da hankali ga mugayen leɓuna; maƙaryaci yakan kasa kunne ga harshen ƙarairayi.

title: Karin Magana 17:5
content: 5 Duk wanda yake wa matalauta ba’a yana zagin Mahaliccinsu ne; duk wanda ya yi murna akan masifar da ta sami wani za a hukunta shi.

title: Karin Magana 17:6
content: 6 Jikoki rawanin tsofaffi ne, kuma iyaye su ne abin taƙamar ’ya’yansu.

title: Karin Magana 17:7
content: 7 Leɓunan basira ba su dace da wawa ba, ya ma fi muni a ce mai mulki yana da leɓunan ƙarya!

title: Karin Magana 17:8
content: 8 Cin hanci kamar sihiri yake ga wanda yake ba da shi; ko’ina ya juye, yakan yi nasara.

title: Karin Magana 17:9
content: 9 Duk wanda ya rufe laifi yana inganta ƙauna ne, amma duk wanda ya yi ta maimaita batu yakan raba abokai na kusa.

title: Karin Magana 17:10
content: 10 Tsawata kan sa mutum ya koyi basira fiye da abin da wawa zai koya ko da an dūke shi sau ɗari.

title: Karin Magana 17:11
content: 11 Mugayen mutane sukan kuta tawaye da Allah; za a aika manzo mutuwa a kansu.

title: Karin Magana 17:12
content: 12 Gara a haɗu da beyar da aka ƙwace wa ’ya’ya fiye da a sadu da wawa cikin wautarsa.

title: Karin Magana 17:13
content: 13 In mutum ya sāka alheri da mugunta, mugunta ba za tă taɓa barin gidansa ba.

title: Karin Magana 17:14
content: 14 Farawar faɗa tana kamar ɓarkewa madatsar ruwa ne, saboda haka ka bar batun kafin faɗa ta ɓarke.

title: Karin Magana 17:15
content: 15 Baratar da mai laifi a kuma hukunta mai adalci, Ubangiji ya ƙi su biyu.

title: Karin Magana 17:16
content: 16 Mene ne amfanin kuɗi a hannun wawa, da yake ba shi da sha’awar samun hikima?

title: Karin Magana 17:17
content: 17 Aboki yakan yi ƙauna a koyaushe, ɗan’uwa kuma, ai, don ɗaukar nawayar juna ne aka haife shi.

title: Karin Magana 17:18
content: 18 Mutumin da ba shi da azanci yakan ɗauki lamunin wani ya kuma ɗauki nauyin biyan basusuwan maƙwabci.

title: Karin Magana 17:19
content: 19 Duk mai son faɗa yana son zunubi, duk wanda ya gina ƙofar shiga mai tsawo yana gayyatar hallaka.

title: Karin Magana 17:20
content: 20 Mutum mai muguwar zuciya ba ya cin gaba; duk wanda yake da harshen ruɗu kan shiga wahala.

title: Karin Magana 17:21
content: 21 Kasance da wawa kamar ɗa yakan kawo baƙin ciki babu farin ciki ga mahaifin wawa.

title: Karin Magana 17:22
content: 22 Zuciya mai farin ciki magani ne mai kyau, amma bakin rai kan busar da ƙasusuwa.

title: Karin Magana 17:23
content: 23 Mugun mutum yakan karɓa cin hanci a asirce don yă lalace yin adalci.

title: Karin Magana 17:24
content: 24 Mutum mai basira kan kafa idonsa a kan hikima, amma idanun wawa suna a kan ƙarshen duniya.

title: Karin Magana 17:25
content: 25 Da yake wawa yakan kawo baƙin ciki ga mahaifinsa da ɓacin rai ga wanda ya haife shi.

title: Karin Magana 17:26
content: 26 Ba shi da kyau a hukunta marar laifi, ko a bulale shugaba saboda mutuncinsu.

title: Karin Magana 17:27
content: 27 Mutum mai sani yakan yi la’akari da amfani da kalmomi, mutum mai basira kuma natsattse ne.

title: Karin Magana 17:28
content: 28 Ko wawa in bai buɗe bakinsa ba, za a zaci shi mai hikima ne, da kuma mai basira inda ya ƙame bakinsa.

title: Karin Magana 18:1
content: 1 Mutumin da ba ya abokantaka yakan nema ya cika burinsa ne kaɗai; yakan ƙi yarda da kowace maganar da take daidai.

title: Karin Magana 18:2
content: 2 Wawa ba ya sha’awa ya sami fahimta amma abin da yake so ya yi kaɗai, shi ne ya ba da ra’ayinsa.

title: Karin Magana 18:3
content: 3 Sa’ad da mugunci ya zo, reni ma kan zo, haka kuma sa’ad da kunya ta zo, shan kunya kan biyo.

title: Karin Magana 18:4
content: 4 Kalmomin bakin mutum suna da zurfi kamar ruwaye, amma maɓulɓulan hikima rafi ne mai gudu.

title: Karin Magana 18:5
content: 5 Ba shi da kyau ka yi wa mugu alheri ko ka hana wa marar laifi adalci.

title: Karin Magana 18:6
content: 6 Leɓunan wawa kan jawo masa faɗa, bakinsa kuma kan gayyaci dūka.

title: Karin Magana 18:7
content: 7 Bakin wawa lalatar da kansa yake yi leɓunansa kuma tarko ne ga ransa.

title: Karin Magana 18:8
content: 8 Kalmomin mai gulma kamar abinci mai daɗi suke; sukan gangara zuwa can cikin gaɓoɓin mutum.

title: Karin Magana 18:9
content: 9 Wanda yake ragwanci a aikinsa ɗan’uwa ne ga wanda yakan lalatar da abubuwa.

title: Karin Magana 18:10
content: 10 Sunan Ubangiji hasumiya ce mai ƙarfi; masu adalci kan gudu zuwa wurinta don su zauna lafiya.

title: Karin Magana 18:11
content: 11 Dukiyar masu arziki ita ce birninsu mai katanga; suna gani cewa ba za a iya huda katangar ba.

title: Karin Magana 18:12
content: 12 Kafin fāɗuwarsa zuciyar mutum takan yi girman kai, amma sauƙinkai kan zo kafin girmamawa.

title: Karin Magana 18:13
content: 13 Duk wanda yakan ba da amsa kafin ya saurara, wannan wauta ce da kuma abin kunya.

title: Karin Magana 18:14
content: 14 Sa rai da mutum ke yi kan taimake shi sa’ad da yake ciwo, amma in ya karai, to, tasa ta ƙare.

title: Karin Magana 18:15
content: 15 Zuciya mai la’akari kan nemi sani; kunnuwan mai hikima kan bincika don yă koya.

title: Karin Magana 18:16
content: 16 Kyauta kan buɗe hanya wa mai bayarwa yakan kuma kai shi a gaban babban mutum.

title: Karin Magana 18:17
content: 17 Wanda ya fara mai da jawabi yakan zama kamar shi ne mai gaskiya, sai wani ya fito ya yi masa tambaya tukuna.

title: Karin Magana 18:18
content: 18 Jefa ƙuri’a kan daidaita tsakanin masu faɗa ta kuma ajiye masu faɗan a rabe.

title: Karin Magana 18:19
content: 19 Ɗan’uwan da aka yi wa laifi ya fi birni mai katanga wuyan shiryawa, kuma faɗace-faɗace suna kama da ƙofofin ƙarfe na fada.

title: Karin Magana 18:20
content: 20 Daga abin da baki ya furta ne cikin mutum kan cika; girbi daga leɓunansa kuma yakan ƙoshi.

title: Karin Magana 18:21
content: 21 Harshe yana da ikon rai da mutuwa, kuma waɗanda suke ƙaunarsa za su ci amfaninsa.

title: Karin Magana 18:22
content: 22 Duk wanda ya sami mace ya sami abu mai kyau ya kuma sami tagomashi daga Ubangiji.

title: Karin Magana 18:23
content: 23 Matalauci kan yi roƙo da taushi, amma mawadaci kan amsa da kakkausar murya.

title: Karin Magana 18:24
content: 24 Mutum mai abokai masu yawa kan lalace, amma akwai abokin da yakan manne kurkusa fiye da ɗan’uwa.

title: Karin Magana 19:1
content: 1 Gara matalauci wanda yake marar laifi da wawa wanda leɓunansa masu ƙarya ne.

title: Karin Magana 19:2
content: 2 Ba shi da kyau ka kasance da niyya babu sani, ko ka kasance mai garaje ka ɓace hanya.

title: Karin Magana 19:3
content: 3 Wautar mutum kan lalatar da ransa, duk da haka zuciyarsa kan ba wa Ubangiji laifi.

title: Karin Magana 19:4
content: 4 Wadata kan kawo abokai da yawa, amma abokin matalauci kan bar shi.

title: Karin Magana 19:5
content: 5 Mai ba da shaidar ƙarya ba zai tafi babu hukunci ba, kuma duk wanda ya baza ƙarairayi ba zai kuɓuta ba.

title: Karin Magana 19:6
content: 6 Kowa na ƙoƙari ya sami farin jini wurin mai mulki, kuma kowa na so a ce shi abokin mutumin nan mai yawan kyauta ne.

title: Karin Magana 19:7
content: 7 ’Yan’uwan matalauci sukan guje shi, balle abokansa, su ma za su guje shi. Ko da yake matalaucin yana binsu yana roƙo, ba zai sam su ba.

title: Karin Magana 19:8
content: 8 Duk wanda ya sami hikima yana ƙaunar ransa; duka wanda yake jin daɗi fahimi kan ci gaba.

title: Karin Magana 19:9
content: 9 Mai shaidar ƙarya ba zai tafi babu hukunci ba, kuma duk mai baza ƙarairayi zai hallaka.

title: Karin Magana 19:10
content: 10 Bai dace da wawa ya yi rayuwa cikin jin daɗi ba, haka ya fi muni bawa ya yi mulki a kan sarki!

title: Karin Magana 19:11
content: 11 Hikimar mutum kan ba shi haƙuri; ɗaukakarsa ce ya ƙyale laifi.

title: Karin Magana 19:12
content: 12 Fushin sarki yana kama da rurin zaki, amma tagomashinsa yana kama da raba a kan ciyawa.

title: Karin Magana 19:13
content: 13 Wawan yaro lalacin mahaifinsa ne, mace mai yawan faɗa tana kama da ɗiɗɗigar ruwa.

title: Karin Magana 19:14
content: 14 Ana gādon dawakai da wadata daga iyaye ne, amma mace mai basira daga Ubangiji ne.

title: Karin Magana 19:15
content: 15 Ragwanci kan jawo zurfin barci, mutum mai sanyin jiki kuma yana tare da yunwa.

title: Karin Magana 19:16
content: 16 Duk wanda ya bi umarnai kan tsare ransa, amma duk wanda ya ƙi binsu zai mutu.

title: Karin Magana 19:17
content: 17 Duk wanda yake kirki ga matalauta yana ba wa Ubangiji bashi ne, zai kuwa sami lada game da abin da ya yi.

title: Karin Magana 19:18
content: 18 Ka hori ɗanka, gama yin haka akwai sa zuciya; kada ka goyi baya lalacewarsa.

title: Karin Magana 19:19
content: 19 Dole mai zafin rai yă biya tara; in ka fisshe shi sau ɗaya, to, sai ka sāke yin haka.

title: Karin Magana 19:20
content: 20 Ka kasa kunne ga shawara ka kuma yarda da umarni, a ƙarshe kuwa za ka yi hikima.

title: Karin Magana 19:21
content: 21 Da yawa ne shirye-shiryen zuciyar mutum, amma manufar Ubangiji ce takan cika.

title: Karin Magana 19:22
content: 22 Abin da mutum yake sha’awa shi ne ƙauna marar ƙarewa; gara ka zama matalauci da ka zama maƙaryaci.

title: Karin Magana 19:23
content: 23 Tsoron Ubangiji yakan kai ga rai. Sa’an nan mutum ya sami biyan bukata, ba abin da zai cuce shi.

title: Karin Magana 19:24
content: 24 Rago kan sa hannunsa a kwano ba ya ma iya ɗaga shi ya kai bakinsa!

title: Karin Magana 19:25
content: 25 Ka bulale mai ba’a, marasa azanci kuwa za su yi la’akari; ka tsawata wa mai basira, zai kuwa ƙara sani.

title: Karin Magana 19:26
content: 26 Duk wanda ya yi wa mahaifinsa fashi ya kuma kori mahaifiyarsa ɗa ne da kan kawo kunya da wulaƙanci.

title: Karin Magana 19:27
content: 27 In ka daina jin umarni, ɗana, za ka kuwa kauce daga kalmomin sani.

title: Karin Magana 19:28
content: 28 Mai shaidar da yake malalaci yana wa shari’a ba’a ne, bakin mugaye kuma na haɗiye mugunta.

title: Karin Magana 19:29
content: 29 An shirya tara saboda masu ba’a ne, dūka kuma saboda bayan wawaye.

title: Karin Magana 20:1
content: 1 Ruwan inabi mai yin ba’a ne, barasa kuma mai rikici ne; duk wanda suka sa ya kauce marar hikima ne.

title: Karin Magana 20:2
content: 2 Fushin sarki yana kama da rurin zaki; duk wanda ya sa shi fushi zai rasa ransa.

title: Karin Magana 20:3
content: 3 Bangirma ne ga mutum ya guji faɗa, amma kowane wawa yana saurin yin faɗa.

title: Karin Magana 20:4
content: 4 Rago ba ya noma a lokacin noma; saboda haka a lokacin girbi ba ya bukata samun kome.

title: Karin Magana 20:5
content: 5 Manufofin zuciyar mutum zurfafan ruwaye ne, amma mutum mai basira yakan jawo su.

title: Karin Magana 20:6
content: 6 Kowane mutum gani yake shi mai ƙauna marar ƙarewa ne, amma ina? Da ƙyar ka sami amintacce mutum guda.

title: Karin Magana 20:7
content: 7 Mai adalci kan yi rayuwa marar abin zargi; masu albarka ne ’ya’yan da za su biyo bayansa.

title: Karin Magana 20:8
content: 8 Sa’ad da sarki ya zauna kan kujerarsa don yă yi shari’a, yakan ga dukan mugunta da idanunsa.

title: Karin Magana 20:9
content: 9 Wa zai iya cewa, “Na kiyaye zuciyata da tsarki; ni mai tsabta ne marar zunubi kuma”?

title: Karin Magana 20:10
content: 10 Ma’auni marar gaskiya da magwajin da ba daidai ba, Ubangiji ya ƙi su duka.

title: Karin Magana 20:11
content: 11 Akan san ƙananan yara ta ayyukansu, ana iya sani ko rayuwarsu amintattu ne, mai nagarta.

title: Karin Magana 20:12
content: 12 Kunnuwan da suke ji da kuma idanun da suke gani, Ubangiji ne ya yi su duka.

title: Karin Magana 20:13
content: 13 Kada ka so barci in ba haka ba za ka talauce; ka zauna a faɗake za ka kuwa kasance da sauran abinci.

title: Karin Magana 20:14
content: 14 “Kai, ya yi tsada, ya yi tsada!” In ji mai saya; sa’ad da ya tafi yana taƙama a kan ya iya ciniki.

title: Karin Magana 20:15
content: 15 Zinariya akwai ta, lu’ulu’u kuma ga shi a yalwace, amma leɓunan da suke magana da sani suna da wuyan samu kamar duwatsu masu daraja.

title: Karin Magana 20:16
content: 16 A karɓi rigunan wanda ya ɗauki lamunin baƙo; a riƙe shi jingina in ya yi shi don mace marar aminci.

title: Karin Magana 20:17
content: 17 Abincin da aka samu ta hanyar zamba yakan zama da daɗi, amma mutum zai ƙarasa da baki cike da yashi.

title: Karin Magana 20:18
content: 18 Ka yi shirye-shirye ta wurin neman shawara; in kana yaƙi, ka sami bishewa.

title: Karin Magana 20:19
content: 19 Mai gulma yakan lalace yarda; saboda haka ka guji mutum mai yawan surutu.

title: Karin Magana 20:20
content: 20 In mutum ya zargi mahaifinsa ko mahaifiyarsa, fitilarsa za tă mutu a tsakiyar duhu.

title: Karin Magana 20:21
content: 21 Gādon da aka samu da sauri a farkon farawa ba zai zama mai albarka a ƙarshe ba.

title: Karin Magana 20:22
content: 22 Kada ka ce, “Zan rama wannan abin da aka yi mini!” Ka dogara ga Ubangiji, zai kuwa fisshe ka.

title: Karin Magana 20:23
content: 23 Ubangiji ya ƙi ma’aunin da ba daidai ba, da kuma magwajin da ba su gamshe shi ba.

title: Karin Magana 20:24
content: 24 Ubangiji ne yake bi da matakan mutum, Ta yaya wani zai fahimci hanyarsa?

title: Karin Magana 20:25
content: 25 Tarko ne ga mutum ya keɓe wani abu da ba tunani daga baya kuma ya yi la’akari da alkawarinsa.

title: Karin Magana 20:26
content: 26 Sarki mai hikima yakan gane mugunta; ya hukunta su ba tausayi.

title: Karin Magana 20:27
content: 27 Fitilar Ubangiji kan bincika zuciyar mutum takan bincika lamirinsa.

title: Karin Magana 20:28
content: 28 Ƙauna da aminci kan kiyaye sarki lafiya; ta wurin ƙauna sarautarsa za tă zauna a kafe.

title: Karin Magana 20:29
content: 29 Ɗaukakar matasa maza ita ce ƙarfinsu, furfura ita ce darajar tsofaffi.

title: Karin Magana 20:30
content: 30 Naushi da rauni kan share mugunta, dūka kuma kan tsabtacce lamiri.

title: Karin Magana 21:1
content: 1 A hannun Ubangiji zuciyar sarki kamar ruwan rafi ne wanda yake bi da shi duk inda ya so.

title: Karin Magana 21:2
content: 2 Mutum zai yi tunani hanyoyinsa daidai suke, amma Ubangiji yakan auna zuciya.

title: Karin Magana 21:3
content: 3 Yin abin da yake daidai da kuma nagari Ubangiji ya fi yarda da shi fiye da hadaya.

title: Karin Magana 21:4
content: 4 Girmankai da fariya, su ne fitilar mugaye, wannan kuwa zunubi ne!

title: Karin Magana 21:5
content: 5 Shirye-shiryen mai aiki tuƙuru kan kai ga riba in kuwa ka cika gaggawa zai kai ga talauci.

title: Karin Magana 21:6
content: 6 Dukiyar da aka samu ta wurin harshe mai yin ƙarya tarin tururi ne da kuma mugun tarko.

title: Karin Magana 21:7
content: 7 Rikicin mugaye zai yi gāba da su, gama sun ƙi su yi abin da yake daidai.

title: Karin Magana 21:8
content: 8 Hanyar mai laifi karkatacciya ce, amma halin marar laifi sukan aikata gaskiya.

title: Karin Magana 21:9
content: 9 Gara a zauna a kusurwar rufin ɗaki da a zauna a gida ɗaya da mace mai fitina.

title: Karin Magana 21:10
content: 10 Mugun mutum yakan zaƙu ya aikata mugunta; maƙwabcinsa ba ya samun jinƙai daga gare shi.

title: Karin Magana 21:11
content: 11 Sa’ad da aka hukunta mai ba’a marasa azanci suka yi wayo; sa’ad da aka yi wa mai hikima umarni yakan sami sani.

title: Karin Magana 21:12
content: 12 Mai Adalci kan lura da gidan mugu kan kuma zama sanadin lalacin mugu.

title: Karin Magana 21:13
content: 13 In mutum ya toshe kunnuwansa ga kukan matalauci, shi ma zai yi kukan neman taimako ba kuwa zai sami amsa ba.

title: Karin Magana 21:14
content: 14 Kyautar da aka yi a asirce takan kwantar da fushi, kuma cin hancin da aka rufe a cikin riga kan tā da fushi mai tsanani.

title: Karin Magana 21:15
content: 15 Sa’ad da aka yi adalci, yakan kawo farin ciki ga mai adalci amma fargaba ga masu aikata mugunta.

title: Karin Magana 21:16
content: 16 Mutumin da ya kauce daga hanyar fahimi kan zo ga hutu a ƙungiyar matattu.

title: Karin Magana 21:17
content: 17 Duk mai son jin daɗi zai zama matalauci; duk mai son ruwan inabi da mai ba zai taɓa zama mai arziki ba.

title: Karin Magana 21:18
content: 18 Mugu kan zama abin fansa don adali, marar aminci kuma don mai aikata gaskiya.

title: Karin Magana 21:19
content: 19 Gara a zauna a hamada da a zauna da mace mai fitina da kuma mugun hali.

title: Karin Magana 21:20
content: 20 A gidan mai hikima akwai wuraren ajiya na abinci da mai masu kyau, amma wawa kan cinye duk abin da yake da shi.

title: Karin Magana 21:21
content: 21 Duk wanda ya nemi adalci da ƙauna kan sami rai, wadata da girmamawa.

title: Karin Magana 21:22
content: 22 Mutum mai hikima kan fāɗa wa birnin jarumawa ya kuma rushe katangar da suka dogara a kai.

title: Karin Magana 21:23
content: 23 Duk wanda yake lura da bakinsa da kuma harshensa kan kiyaye kansa daga masifa.

title: Karin Magana 21:24
content: 24 Mai girmankai da kuma mai fariya, “Mai ba’a” ne sunansa; yana yin abubuwa da girmankai ainun.

title: Karin Magana 21:25
content: 25 Marmarin rago zai zama mutuwarsa, domin hannuwansa sun ƙi su yi aiki.

title: Karin Magana 21:26
content: 26 Dukan yini yana marmari ya sami ƙari, amma mai adalci yakan bayar hannu sake.

title: Karin Magana 21:27
content: 27 Hadayar mugaye abin ƙyama ne, balle ma in aka kawo da mugun nufi!

title: Karin Magana 21:28
content: 28 Mai ba da shaidar ƙarya zai hallaka, kuma duk wanda ya saurare shi zai hallaka har abada.

title: Karin Magana 21:29
content: 29 Mugun mutum kan yi tsayin daka, amma mai aikata gaskiya kan yi tunani a kan abin da yake yi.

title: Karin Magana 21:30
content: 30 Babu hikima, babu tunani, babu shirin da zai yi nasara a kan Ubangiji.

title: Karin Magana 21:31
content: 31 Akan shirya doki domin ranar yaƙi, amma nasara tana ga Ubangiji ne.

title: Karin Magana 22:1
content: 1 An fi son suna mai kyau fiye da wadata mai yawa; tagomashi kuma ya fi azurfa ko zinariya.

title: Karin Magana 22:2
content: 2 Mawadaci da matalauci suna da abu guda. Ubangiji ne Mahaliccinsu duka.

title: Karin Magana 22:3
content: 3 Mai basira kan ga damuwa tana zuwa yă nemi mafaka, amma marar azanci kan yi ta tafiya yă kuma sha wahala.

title: Karin Magana 22:4
content: 4 Sauƙinkai da tsoron Ubangiji sukan kawo wadata da girmamawa da kuma rai.

title: Karin Magana 22:5
content: 5 A hanyoyin mugu akwai kaya da tarko, amma duk wanda ya kiyaye ransa kan kauce musu.

title: Karin Magana 22:6
content: 6 Ka hori yaro a hanyar da ya kamata yă bi, kuma sa’ad da ya tsufa ba zai bar ta ba.

title: Karin Magana 22:7
content: 7 Mawadaci yakan yi mulki a kan matalauci, mai cin bashi kuwa bawan mai ba da bashi ne.

title: Karin Magana 22:8
content: 8 Duk wanda ya shuka mugunta yakan girbe wahala, za a kuma hallaka sandar fushinsa.

title: Karin Magana 22:9
content: 9 Mai bayarwa hannu sake shi kansa zai sami albarka, gama yakan raba abincinsa da matalauta.

title: Karin Magana 22:10
content: 10 Ka hori mai ba’a, hatsaniya kuwa za tă yi waje; fitina da zargi kuma za su ƙare.

title: Karin Magana 22:11
content: 11 Duk mai son tsabtar zuciya wanda kuma jawabinsa mai alheri ne zai zama aminin sarki.

title: Karin Magana 22:12
content: 12 Idanun Ubangiji na lura da sani, amma yakan ƙi kalmomin marar aminci.

title: Karin Magana 22:13
content: 13 Rago kan ce, “Akwai zaki a waje!” Ko kuma “Za a kashe ni a tituna!”

title: Karin Magana 22:14
content: 14 Bakin mazinaciya rami ne mai zurfi; duk wanda yake a ƙarƙashin fushin Ubangiji zai fāɗa a ciki.

title: Karin Magana 22:15
content: 15 Wauta tana da yawa a zuciyar yara, amma sandar horo zai kore ta nesa da su.

title: Karin Magana 22:16
content: 16 Duk wanda yake danne matalauta don yă azurta kuma duk wanda yake kyauta ga mawadata, dukansu kan talauta.

title: Karin Magana 22:17
content: 17 Ka kasa kunne ka kuma saurara ga maganganu masu hikima; ka yi amfani da abin da nake koyarwa,

title: Karin Magana 22:18
content: 18 gama yana da daɗi sa’ad da ka kiyaye su a zuciyarka ka kuma kasance da su a shirye a leɓunanka.

title: Karin Magana 22:19
content: 19 Domin dogarawarka ta kasance ga Ubangiji, ina koya maka yau, har kai ma.

title: Karin Magana 22:20
content: 20 Ban rubuta maka maganganu talatin ba, maganganun shawara da sani,

title: Karin Magana 22:21
content: 21 ina koya maka gaskiya da kalmomin da za ka dogara a kai, saboda ka iya ba da amsa daidai ga duk wanda ya aike ka?

title: Karin Magana 22:22
content: 22 Kada ka zalunci matalauta a kan suna matalauta kada kuma ka ƙwari wanda ba shi da mai taimako a gaban shari’a,

title: Karin Magana 22:23
content: 23 gama Ubangiji zai yi magana dominsu zai kuwa washe waɗanda suka washe su.

title: Karin Magana 22:24
content: 24 Kada ka yi abokantaka da mai zafin rai, kada ka haɗa kai da wanda ba shi da wuya ya yi fushi,

title: Karin Magana 22:25
content: 25 in ba haka ba za ka koyi hanyoyinsa ka kuma sa kanka a tarko.

title: Karin Magana 22:26
content: 26 Kada ka zama mai ɗaukar lamuni ko ka ba da jingina saboda bashi;

title: Karin Magana 22:27
content: 27 gama in ka kāsa biya za a ƙwace gadon da kake kwanciya a kai ma.

title: Karin Magana 22:28
content: 28 Kada ka matsar da shaidar kan iyakar da kakanninka suka kafa.

title: Karin Magana 22:29
content: 29 Kana ganin mutumin da yake da gwaninta a cikin aikinsa? Zai yi wa sarakuna hidima; ba zai yi hidima wa mutanen da ba su iya ba.

title: Karin Magana 23:1
content: 1 Sa’ad da ka zauna domin cin abinci da mai mulki, ka lura sosai da abin da yake gabanka,

title: Karin Magana 23:2
content: 2 ka kuma sa wuƙa a maƙogwaronka in kai mai ci da yawa ne.

title: Karin Magana 23:3
content: 3 Kada ka yi marmarin abincinsa mai daɗi gama wannan abinci ruɗu ne.

title: Karin Magana 23:4
content: 4 Kada ka gajiyar da kanka don ka yi arziki; ka kasance da hikimar dainawa.

title: Karin Magana 23:5
content: 5 Da ƙyiftawar ido a kan wadata ta ɓace, gama tabbatacce sukan yi fikafikai sukan tashi sama kamar gaggafa.

title: Karin Magana 23:6
content: 6 Kada ka ci abincin mai rowa, kada ka yi marmarin abincinsa mai daɗi;

title: Karin Magana 23:7
content: 7 gama shi wani irin mutum ne wanda kullum yana tunani game da tsadar abincin. Zai ce maka, “Ci ka sha,” amma zuciyarsa ba ta tare da kai.

title: Karin Magana 23:8
content: 8 Za ka yi amai ɗan abin da ka ci dukan daɗin bakinka kuwa zai tafi a banza.

title: Karin Magana 23:9
content: 9 Kada ka yi magana da wawa, gama zai yi wa maganar hikimarka ba’a.

title: Karin Magana 23:10
content: 10 Kada ka kawar da shaidar iyaka ta dā ko ka ɗiba gonar marayu,

title: Karin Magana 23:11
