content: 11 gama mai Kāriyarsu yana da ƙarfi; zai kuwa yi magana dominsu.

title: Karin Magana 23:12
content: 12 Ka mai da hankali ga umarni ka kuma kasa kunne ga kalmomin sani.

title: Karin Magana 23:13
content: 13 Kada ka bar yaro ba horo; in ka yi masa horo da sanda, ba zai mutu ba.

title: Karin Magana 23:14
content: 14 Ka hukunta shi da sanda ka ceci ransa daga mutuwa.

title: Karin Magana 23:15
content: 15 Ɗana, in zuciyarka mai hikima ce, to, zuciyata za tă yi murna;

title: Karin Magana 23:16
content: 16 cikin cikina zai yi farin ciki in leɓunanka suna maganar abin da yake daidai.

title: Karin Magana 23:17
content: 17 Kada ka bar zuciyarka tă yi ƙyashin masu zunubi, amma kullum tsoron Ubangiji za ka yi kishi.

title: Karin Magana 23:18
content: 18 Tabbatacce akwai sa zuciya ta nan gaba dominka, kuma sa zuciyarka ba za tă zama a banza ba.

title: Karin Magana 23:19
content: 19 Ka saurara, ɗana, ka zama mai hikima, ka kafa zuciyarka a hanyar da take daidai.

title: Karin Magana 23:20
content: 20 Kada ka haɗa kai da waɗanda suke shan ruwan inabi da yawa ko masu haɗama kansu da abinci,

title: Karin Magana 23:21
content: 21 gama bugaggu da ruwan inabi da masu yawan ci sukan zama matalauta, gama jiri yakan yi musu sutura da tsummoki.

title: Karin Magana 23:22
content: 22 Ka kasa kunne ga mahaifinka, wanda ya ba ka rai, kada kuwa ka rena mahaifiyarka sa’ad da ta tsufa.

title: Karin Magana 23:23
content: 23 Ka saye gaskiya kada kuwa ka sayar da ita; ka nemi hikima, horo da fahimi.

title: Karin Magana 23:24
content: 24 Mahaifin adali yana da farin ciki sosai; duk wanda yake da ɗa mai hikima yakan ji daɗinsa.

title: Karin Magana 23:25
content: 25 Bari mahaifinka da mahaifiyarka su yi murna; bari wadda ta haife ka tă yi farin ciki!

title: Karin Magana 23:26
content: 26 Ɗana, ka ba ni zuciyarka bari kuma idanunka su kiyaye hanyoyina,

title: Karin Magana 23:27
content: 27 gama karuwa rami ne mai zurfi mace marar aminci matsattsiyar rijiya ce.

title: Karin Magana 23:28
content: 28 Kamar ’yan fashi, takan kwanta tana jira tana kuma ninka rashin aminci a cikin maza.

title: Karin Magana 23:29
content: 29 Wa yake wayyo? Wa yake baƙin ciki? Wa yake neman fada? Wa yake gunaguni? Wa yake da raunuka ba dalili? Wa yake da jan idanu?

title: Karin Magana 23:30
content: 30 Waɗanda suke daɗe suna shan ruwan inabi, waɗanda suke neman ƙoƙon damammen ruwan inabi.

title: Karin Magana 23:31
content: 31 Kada ka ƙyifce ido a ruwan inabi sa’ad da ya yi ja, sa’ad da yana da kyan gani a cikin ƙwarya, sa’ad da yana gangarawa sumul a maƙogwaro!

title: Karin Magana 23:32
content: 32 A ƙarshe yana sara kamar maciji da kuma dafi kamar gamsheƙa.

title: Karin Magana 23:33
content: 33 Idanunka za su riƙa gane-gane, zuciyarka kuma za su riƙa tunani abubuwa masu rikitarwa.

title: Karin Magana 23:34
content: 34 Za ka zama kamar wanda yake barci a tsakiyar tekuna, kwance a sama itacen jirgin ruwa.

title: Karin Magana 23:35
content: 35 Za ka ce “Sun buge ni, amma ban ji ciwo ba! Sun daddoke ni, amma ba na jin zafinsa! Yaushe zan farka don in ƙara shan wani?”

title: Karin Magana 24:1
content: 1 Kada ka yi ƙyashin mugaye, kada ka yi sha’awar ƙungiyarsu;

title: Karin Magana 24:2
content: 2 gama leɓunansu suna maganar tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye ne.

title: Karin Magana 24:3
content: 3 Ta wurin hikima ce ake gina gida, kuma ta wurin fahimi ake kafa ta;

title: Karin Magana 24:4
content: 4 ta wurin sani ɗakunanta sukan cika da kyawawan kayayyaki masu daraja.

title: Karin Magana 24:5
content: 5 Mutum mai hikima yana da iko sosai, kuma mutum mai sani yakan ƙaru da ƙarfi;

title: Karin Magana 24:6
content: 6 don yin yaƙi kana bukatar bishewa, kuma don ka yi nasara kana bukatar mashawarta masu yawa.

title: Karin Magana 24:7
content: 7 Hikima ta yi wa wawa nisa ƙwarai a cikin taro a ƙofar gari ba shi da ta cewa.

title: Karin Magana 24:8
content: 8 Duk mai ƙulla mugunta za a ɗauka shi mai kuta hargitsi ne.

title: Karin Magana 24:9
content: 9 Makircin wawa zunubi ne, mutane kuma sukan yi ƙyamar mai ba’a.

title: Karin Magana 24:10
content: 10 In ba ka da ƙarfi a lokacin wahala, ka tabbatar kai marar ƙarfi ne sosai!

title: Karin Magana 24:11
content: 11 Ka kuɓutar da waɗanda ake ja zuwa inda za a kashe su; ka riƙe waɗanda suke tangaɗi zuwa wajen yanka.

title: Karin Magana 24:12
content: 12 In kuka ce, “Ai, ba mu san wani abu a kai wannan ba,” shi da yake awon ba shi da zuciyar ganewa ne? Shi da yake tsare ranka bai sani ba ne? Ba zai sāka wa kowane mutum bisa ga abin da ya aikata ba?

title: Karin Magana 24:13
content: 13 Ka sha zuma, ɗana, ka sha zuma gama tana da kyau; zuma daga kaki yana da zaƙi a harshenka.

title: Karin Magana 24:14
content: 14 Ka kuma san cewa hikima tana da zaƙi ga rai; in ka same ta, akwai sa zuciya ta nan gaba dominka, kuma sa zuciyarka ba za tă zama a banza ba.

title: Karin Magana 24:15
content: 15 Kada ka kwanta kana fako kamar ɗan iska don ƙwace gidan adali, kada ka ƙwace masa wurin zama;

title: Karin Magana 24:16
content: 16 gama ko da adali ya fāɗi sau bakwai, yakan tashi kuma, amma bala’i kan kwantar da mugaye.

title: Karin Magana 24:17
content: 17 Kada ka yi dariya sa’ad da abokin gāba ya fāɗi; sa’ad da ya yi tuntuɓe, kada ka yi farin ciki,

title: Karin Magana 24:18
content: 18 in ba haka ba in Ubangiji ya gani ba zai amince ba ya kuma juye fushinsa daga gare shi.

title: Karin Magana 24:19
content: 19 Kada ka ji tsoro saboda masu mugunta ko ka yi ƙyashin mugaye,

title: Karin Magana 24:20
content: 20 gama mugu ba shi da zuciya ta nan gaba, kuma fitilar mugaye za tă mutu.

title: Karin Magana 24:21
content: 21 Ka ji tsoron Ubangiji da kuma sarki, ɗana, kuma kada ka haɗa kai da masu tayarwa,

title: Karin Magana 24:22
content: 22 gama za a tura waɗannan biyu zuwa hallaka nan da nan, kuma wa ya sani irin bala’in da za su iya kawowa?

title: Karin Magana 24:23
content: 23 Waɗannan ma maganganun masu hikima ne, Nunan sonkai a shari’a ba shi da kyau.

title: Karin Magana 24:24
content: 24 Duk wanda ya ce wa mai laifi, “Ba ka da laifi”, mutane za su la’ance shi al’umma kuma za tă ce ba a san shi ba.

title: Karin Magana 24:25
content: 25 Amma zai zama da lafiya ga duk waɗanda suka hukunta masu laifi, kuma babban albarka zai zo a kansu.

title: Karin Magana 24:26
content: 26 Amsa da take ta gaskiya tana kamar sumba a leɓuna.

title: Karin Magana 24:27
content: 27 Ka gama aikinka ka kuma shirya gonakinka; bayan haka, ka gina gidanka.

title: Karin Magana 24:28
content: 28 Kada ka ba da shaida a kan maƙwabcinka ba tare da isashen dalili ba, ko ka yi amfani da leɓunanka ka yi ruɗu.

title: Karin Magana 24:29
content: 29 Kada ka ce, “Zan yi masa kamar yadda ya yi mini; zan rama abin da wannan mutum ya yi mini.”

title: Karin Magana 24:30
content: 30 Na wuce cikin gonar rago, na wuce cikin gonar inabin mutumin da ba shi da azanci;

title: Karin Magana 24:31
content: 31 ƙayayyuwa sun yi girma ko’ina, ciyayi sun rufe ƙasar, katangar duwatsu duk ta rushe.

title: Karin Magana 24:32
content: 32 Na yi tunani a zuciyata na kuwa koyi darasi daga abin da na gani.

title: Karin Magana 24:33
content: 33 Ɗan barci, ɗan gyangyaɗi, ɗan naɗin hannuwa don a huta,

title: Karin Magana 24:34
content: 34 sai talauci ya shigo maka kamar ’yan fashi rashi kuma ya zo maka kamar mai hari.

title: Karin Magana 25:1
content: 1 Waɗannan ƙarin karin maganar Solomon ne waɗanda mutanen Hezekiya sarkin Yahuda suka tara.

title: Karin Magana 25:2
content: 2 Ɗaukakar Allah ce a ɓoye batun; a bayyana batun kuwa ɗaukakar sarakuna ne.

title: Karin Magana 25:3
content: 3 Kamar yadda sammai suna can bisa duniya kuma tana da zurfi, haka zukatan sarakuna suka wuce a bincika.

title: Karin Magana 25:4
content: 4 Ka tace azurfa sai kayan su fito don maƙerin azurfa;

title: Karin Magana 25:5
content: 5 ka cire mugaye daga gaban sarki, kursiyinsa kuwa zai kahu ta wurin adalci.

title: Karin Magana 25:6
content: 6 Kada ka ɗaukaka kanka a gaban sarki, kada kuma ka nemi wa kanka wuri a cikin manyan mutane;

title: Karin Magana 25:7
content: 7 gara ya ce maka, “Ka hauro nan,” da a ƙasƙantar da kai a gaban wani mai makami. Abin da ka gani da idanunka

title: Karin Magana 25:8
content: 8 kada ka yi garaje kai ƙara a majalisa, gama me za ka yi a ƙarshe in maƙwabcinka ya ba ka kunya?

title: Karin Magana 25:9
content: 9 In kai da maƙwabcinka kuka yi gardama, kada ka tona asirin wani,

title: Karin Magana 25:10
content: 10 in ba haka ba duk wanda ya ji zai kunyata ka ba za ka kuma taɓa rabuwa da wannan mummuna suna ba.

title: Karin Magana 25:11
content: 11 Kalmar da aka faɗa daidai tana kamar zubin zinariyar da aka yi a mazubin azurfa.

title: Karin Magana 25:12
content: 12 Kamar ’yan kunnen zinariya ko kuwa kayan ado na zinariya zalla haka yake da tsawatawar mai hikima ga kunne mai saurarawa.

title: Karin Magana 25:13
content: 13 Kamar sanyin ƙanƙara a lokacin girbi haka ɗan saƙo mai aminci wanda aka aika; ya wartsakar da ran waɗanda suka aike shi.

title: Karin Magana 25:14
content: 14 Kamar gizagizai da kuma iska marar ruwan sama haka mutumin da yake fariya a kan kyautan da ba ya bayarwa.

title: Karin Magana 25:15
content: 15 Ta wurin haƙuri akan rinjaye mai mulki, magana mai hankali kan karye ƙashi.

title: Karin Magana 25:16
content: 16 In ka sami zuma, ka sha isashe kawai, in ya yi yawa, za ka yi amai.

title: Karin Magana 25:17
content: 17 Kada ka cika ziyarar gidan maƙwabcinka yawan ganinka zai sa ya ƙi ka.

title: Karin Magana 25:18
content: 18 Kamar sanda ko takobi ko kibiya mai tsini haka yake da mutumin da yake ba da shaidar ƙarya a kan maƙwabcinsa.

title: Karin Magana 25:19
content: 19 Kamar haƙori mai ciwo ko yin tafiya da gurguwar ƙafa haka yake ga mai dogara da marasa aminci a lokacin wahala.

title: Karin Magana 25:20
content: 20 Kamar wanda ya tuɓe riga a ranar da ake sanyi, ko kuwa kamar zuba ruwan tsami a kanwa, haka yake da mai rera waƙoƙi ga mai baƙin ciki.

title: Karin Magana 25:21
content: 21 In abokin gābanka yana jin yunwa, ka ba shi abinci ya ci; in yana jin ƙishi, ka ba shi ruwa ya sha.

title: Karin Magana 25:22
content: 22 Ta yin haka, za ka tara garwashin wuta mai ci a kansa, Ubangiji kuma zai sāka maka.

title: Karin Magana 25:23
content: 23 Kamar yadda iskar arewa kan kawo ruwan sama, haka jita-jita kan kawo fushi.

title: Karin Magana 25:24
content: 24 Gara a zauna a kusurwar rufin ɗaki da a zauna a gida ɗaya da mace mai fitina.

title: Karin Magana 25:25
content: 25 Kamar ruwan sanyi ga ran da ya gaji haka yake da jin labari mai daɗi daga ƙasa mai nisa.

title: Karin Magana 25:26
content: 26 Kamar rafi mai laka ko rijiyar da ta gurɓace haka yake da mai adalci wanda ya miƙa wuya ga mugaye.

title: Karin Magana 25:27
content: 27 Ba shi da kyau ka sha zuma da yawa, haka ma ba shi da kyau ka nemi girma wa kanka.

title: Karin Magana 25:28
content: 28 Kamar birni da katangarsa sun rushe haka yake da mutumin da ba ya iya danne fushinsa.

title: Karin Magana 26:1
content: 1 Kamar ƙanƙara a rani ko ruwan sama a lokacin girbi, haka girmamawa bai dace da wawa ba.

title: Karin Magana 26:2
content: 2 Kamar gwara mai yawo ko alallaka mai firiya, haka yake da la’anar da ba tă dace tă kama ka ba take.

title: Karin Magana 26:3
content: 3 Bulala don doki, linzami don jaki, sanda kuma don bayan wawaye!

title: Karin Magana 26:4
content: 4 Kada ka amsa wa wawa bisa ga wautarsa, in ba haka ba kai kanka za ka zama kamar sa.

title: Karin Magana 26:5
content: 5 Ka amsa wa wawa bisa ga wautarsa, in ba haka ba zai ga kansa mai hikima ne.

title: Karin Magana 26:6
content: 6 Kamar datsewar ƙafafun wani ko shan dafi haka yake da a aika da saƙo ta hannun wawa.

title: Karin Magana 26:7
content: 7 Kamar ƙafafun gurgun da suka yi laƙwas haka karin magana yake a bakin wawa.

title: Karin Magana 26:8
content: 8 Kamar ɗaura dutse a majajjawa haka yake da girmama wawa.

title: Karin Magana 26:9
content: 9 Kamar suƙar ƙaya a hannun wanda ya bugu haka karin magana yake a bakin wawa.

title: Karin Magana 26:10
content: 10 Kamar maharbi wanda yake jin wa kowa rauni haka yake da duk wanda ya yi hayan wawa ko wani mai wucewa.

title: Karin Magana 26:11
content: 11 Kamar yadda kare kan koma ga amansa, haka wawa kan maimaita wautarsa.

title: Karin Magana 26:12
content: 12 Gwamma riƙaƙƙen wawa da mutum mai ganin kansa mai hikima ne.

title: Karin Magana 26:13
content: 13 Rago yakan ce, “Akwai zaki a kan hanya, zaki mai faɗa yana yawo a tituna!”

title: Karin Magana 26:14
content: 14 Kamar yadda ƙofa kan juya a ƙyaurensa, haka rago yake jujjuya a gadonsa.

title: Karin Magana 26:15
content: 15 Rago kan sa hannunsa a kwano ba ya ma iya ɗaga shi ya kai bakinsa.

title: Karin Magana 26:16
content: 16 Rago yana gani yana da hikima fiye da mutane bakwai da suke ba da amsa da dalilai a kan ra’ayinsu.

title: Karin Magana 26:17
content: 17 Kamar wani da ya kama kare a kunnuwa haka yake da mai wucewa da ya tsoma baki a faɗan da ba ruwansa.

title: Karin Magana 26:18
content: 18 Kamar yadda mahaukaci yake harbin cukwimai ko kibiyoyi masu dafi

title: Karin Magana 26:19
content: 19 haka yake da mutumin da ya ruɗe maƙwabci sa’an nan ya ce, “Wasa ne kawai nake yi!”

title: Karin Magana 26:20
content: 20 In ba itace wuta takan mutu; haka kuma in ba mai gulma ba za a yi faɗa ba.

title: Karin Magana 26:21
content: 21 Kamar yadda gawayi yake ga murhu, itace kuma ga wuta, haka mutum mai neman faɗa yake ga faɗa.

title: Karin Magana 26:22
content: 22 Kalmomin mai gulma suna kama da burodi mai daɗi; sukan gangara can cikin cikin mutum.

title: Karin Magana 26:23
content: 23 Kamar kaskon da aka dalaye da azurfar da ba a tace ba haka leɓuna masu mugun zuciya.

title: Karin Magana 26:24
content: 24 Mai yin ƙiyayya yakan ɓoye kansa da maganar bakinsa, amma a cikin zuciyarsa yana cike da munafunci

title: Karin Magana 26:25
content: 25 Ko da jawabinsa ya ɗauki hankali, kada ka gaskata shi, gama abubuwa ƙyama guda bakwai sun cika zuciyarsa.

title: Karin Magana 26:26
content: 26 Wataƙila ya ɓoye ƙiyayyarsa da ƙarya, duk da haka za a tone muguntarsa a cikin taro.

title: Karin Magana 26:27
content: 27 In mutum ya haƙa rami, shi zai fāɗi a ciki; in mutum ya mirgino dutse, dutsen zai mirgine a kansa.

title: Karin Magana 26:28
content: 28 Harshe mai faɗin ƙarya yana ƙin waɗanda yake ɓata musu rai, daɗin baki kuma yakan aikata ɓarna.

title: Karin Magana 27:1
content: 1 Kada ka yi fariya a kan gobe gama ba san abin da ranar za tă kawo ba.

title: Karin Magana 27:2
content: 2 Ka bar wani ya yabe ka, ba kai kanka ba; wani dabam, ba leɓunanka ba.

title: Karin Magana 27:3
content: 3 Dutse yana da nauyi yashi kuma wahala ce, amma tsokanar wawa ta fi su duka nauyi.

title: Karin Magana 27:4
content: 4 Fushi mugun abu ne mai hallakarwa, amma wa zai iya tsaya a gaban kishi?

title: Karin Magana 27:5
content: 5 Gara tsawatawar da ake yi a fili da ƙaunar da ake yi a ɓoye.

title: Karin Magana 27:6
content: 6 Za a iya amince da rauni daga aboki, amma abokin gāba ko da ya sumbace ka kada ka sake da shi!

title: Karin Magana 27:7
content: 7 Duk wanda ya ƙoshi da zuma, ba ya marmarinsa kuma amma wanda yake yunwa ko abin da yake da ɗaci ma zai ji shi da zaƙi.

title: Karin Magana 27:8
content: 8 Kamar tsuntsun da ya ɓace daga sheƙarsa haka yake da mutumin da ya bar gidansa.

title: Karin Magana 27:9
content: 9 Man shafawa mai ƙanshi da kuma turare kan faranta zuciya, gaisuwar amini kuma takan fito daga shawarar kirki.

title: Karin Magana 27:10
content: 10 Kada ka manta da abokinka da kuma abokin mahaifinka, kuma kada ka tafi gidan ɗan’uwanka sa’ad da masifa ta same ka, gara ka je wurin maƙwabci na kusa da ka je wurin ɗan’uwan da yake da nisa.

title: Karin Magana 27:11
content: 11 Ka zama mai hikima, ɗana, ka kuma faranta mini zuciya; zan iya amsa kowace irin suƙar da wani zai yi mini.

title: Karin Magana 27:12
content: 12 Mai basira kan hango hatsari ya kuma kauce, marar azanci zai yi ta kutsa kai ciki, daga baya ya yi da na sani.

title: Karin Magana 27:13
content: 13 A karɓe rigunan wanda ya ɗauki lamunin baƙo; a riƙe shi jingina in ya yi shi don mace marar aminci.

title: Karin Magana 27:14
content: 14 In mutum ya albarkaci maƙwabcinsa da murya mai ƙarfi da sassafe, za a ɗauka shi a matsayin la’ana.

title: Karin Magana 27:15
content: 15 Mace mai fitina kamar ɗiɗɗigar ruwa take ba ƙaƙƙautawa;

title: Karin Magana 27:16
content: 16 hana ta yana kamar yin ƙoƙari tsai da iska ne ko yin ƙoƙarin cafke mai a tafin hannunka.

title: Karin Magana 27:17
content: 17 Kamar yadda ƙarfe kan wasa ƙarfe haka mutum kan koyi daga mutum.

title: Karin Magana 27:18
content: 18 Duk wanda ya lura da itacen ɓaure, zai ci ’ya’yansa, kuma duk wanda ya lura da maigidansa za a girmama shi.

title: Karin Magana 27:19
content: 19 Kamar yadda ruwa kan nuna yadda fuska take, haka zuciyar mutum kan nuna irin mutumin.

title: Karin Magana 27:20
content: 20 Mutuwa da Hallaka ba sa ƙoshi, haka idanun mutum ba sa ƙoshi da gani.

title: Karin Magana 27:21
content: 21 Ana gwajin azurfa da kuma zinariya da wuta, amma akan gwada mutum ta wurin yabon da ya samu.

title: Karin Magana 27:22
content: 22 Ko da ka daka wawa a turmi, kana daka shi kamar hatsi da taɓarya, ba za ka fid da wauta daga gare shi ba.

title: Karin Magana 27:23
content: 23 Ka tabbata ka san lafiyar garken tumakinka, ka mai da hankali ga garken shanunka;

title: Karin Magana 27:24
content: 24 domin dukiya ba ta dawwama har abada, ba a kuma kasance da rawani daga tsara zuwa tsara.

title: Karin Magana 27:25
content: 25 Sa’ad da aka yanki ingirci sabon toho kuma ya bayyana aka kuma tattara ciyawa daga tuddai,

title: Karin Magana 27:26
content: 26 gashin raguna za su tanada maka tufafi, za ka iya sayi gonaki masu kyau da kuɗin awaki.

title: Karin Magana 27:27
content: 27 Za ka kasance da madarar awaki mai yawa don ka ciyar da kanka da kuma iyalinka ka kuma inganta bayinka mata.

title: Karin Magana 28:1
content: 1 Mugu yakan gudu ko babu wanda yake korarsa, amma adalai suna da ƙarfin hali kamar zaki.

title: Karin Magana 28:2
content: 2 Sa’ad da ƙasa ta yi tayarwa, takan kasance da masu mulki da yawa, amma mai fahimi da sani kan mai da zaman lafiya.

title: Karin Magana 28:3
content: 3 Mai mulkin da ya danne talakawa yana kama da ruwan saman da ya lalatar da hatsi.

title: Karin Magana 28:4
content: 4 Duk waɗanda ba sa bin doka yabon mugaye suke yi, amma waɗanda suke yin biyayya da doka suna gāba da mugaye ke nan.

title: Karin Magana 28:5
content: 5 Mugaye ba su san gaskiya ba, amma waɗanda suke neman Ubangiji sun santa sosai.

title: Karin Magana 28:6
content: 6 Gara matalauci wanda yake tafiya babu abin zargi da mai arziki wanda hanyoyinsa mugaye ne.

title: Karin Magana 28:7
content: 7 Duk wanda ya kiyaye doka ɗa ne mai la’akari, amma wanda yake abokantaka da masu zari yakan jawo wa mahaifinsa kunya.

title: Karin Magana 28:8
content: 8 Duk wanda ya tara dukiyarsa ta wurin ba da bashi da ruwan da ya wuce misali yana tara wa wani ne wanda zai yi wa talakawa alheri.

title: Karin Magana 28:9
content: 9 In wani ya yi kunnuwa ƙashi ga doka ko addu’arsa ma abar ƙyama ce.

title: Karin Magana 28:10
content: 10 Duk wanda ya jagorance masu aikata gaskiya a hanyar mugunta zai fāɗa cikin tarkonsa amma marasa abin zargi za su sami gādo mai kyau.

title: Karin Magana 28:11
content: 11 Mai arziki zai yi zato shi mai hikima ne a ganinsa, amma matalauci mai basira ya fi shi sanin abin da yake daidai.

title: Karin Magana 28:12
content: 12 Sa’ad da adalai suka yi nasara, kowa yakan yi biki; amma sa’ad da mugu ya samu shugabanci, mutane sukan yi ta ɓuya.

title: Karin Magana 28:13
content: 13 Duk wanda ya ɓoye zunubansa ba ya taɓa cin nasara, amma duk wanda ya furta ya kuma ƙi su yakan sami jinƙai.

title: Karin Magana 28:14
content: 14 Mai albarka ne mutumin da kullum yake jin tsoron Allah, amma duk wanda ya taurare zuciyarsa yakan shiga wahala.

title: Karin Magana 28:15
content: 15 Kamar rurin zaki ko sanɗar beyar haka mugun mutum mai mulki a kan mutane marasa ƙarfi yake.

title: Karin Magana 28:16
content: 16 Mugu mai mulki ba shi da azanci, amma duk wanda yake ƙin ƙazamar riba yakan yi tsawon rai.

title: Karin Magana 28:17
content: 17 Mutumin da laifin kisa ya yi ta damunsa zai zama mai gudu don tsoro har mutuwa; kada wani ya taimake shi.

title: Karin Magana 28:18
content: 18 Duk wanda ya yi tafiya marar abin zargi zai zauna lafiya, amma duk wanda hanyoyinsa mugaye ne zai fāɗi nan da nan.

title: Karin Magana 28:19
content: 19 Duk wanda ya nome gonarsa zai sami amfani a yalwace, amma duk wanda yake zaman banza zai zama matalauci a koyaushe.

title: Karin Magana 28:20
content: 20 Mutum mai aminci zai cika da albarka, amma duk mai son yin arziki dare ɗaya zai sha hukunci.

title: Karin Magana 28:21
content: 21 Nuna sonkai ba shi da kyau, duk da haka mutum zai aikata abin da ba daidai ba saboda ’yar ƙaramar rashawa.

title: Karin Magana 28:22
content: 22 Mai rowa yana alla-alla ya yi arziki bai san cewa talauci ne ke jiransa ba.

title: Karin Magana 28:23
content: 23 Duk wanda ya tsawata wa wani mutum zai sami yabo a ƙarshe fiye da wanda yake mai daɗin baki.

title: Karin Magana 28:24
content: 24 Duk wanda ya yi wa mahaifin ko mahaifiyarsa sata ya kuma ce, “Ai, ba laifi ba ne” abokin mai hallakarwa ne shi.

title: Karin Magana 28:25
content: 25 Mai haɗama yakan jawo tā-da-na-zaune-tsaye, amma duk wanda ya dogara ga Ubangiji zai yi nasara.

title: Karin Magana 28:26
content: 26 Duk mai dogara ga kansa wawa ne, amma duk wanda yake tafiya da hikima zai zauna lafiya.

title: Karin Magana 28:27
content: 27 Duk wanda yake bayarwa ga matalauta ba zai rasa kome ba, amma duk wanda bai kula da su ba yana samu la’ana masu yawa.

title: Karin Magana 28:28
content: 28 Sa’ad da mugu ya samu shugabanci, mutane sukan yi ta ɓuya; amma sa’ad da mugu ya hallaka, adali kan ci gaba cikin arziki da lafiya.

title: Karin Magana 29:1
content: 1 Mutumin da ya ci gaba da taurinkai bayan an kwaɓe shi ba da daɗewa ba zai hallaka ba makawa.

title: Karin Magana 29:2
content: 2 Sa’ad da masu adalci suke cin nasara, mutane kan yi farin ciki sa’ad da mugaye suke mulki, mutane kan yi nishi.

title: Karin Magana 29:3
content: 3 Duk mai ƙaunar hikima kan kawo wa mahaifinsa farin ciki, amma wanda yake ma’amala da karuwai kan lalatar da dukiyarsa.

title: Karin Magana 29:4
content: 4 Ta wurin yin adalci sarki kan sa ƙasa tă yi ƙarƙo amma duk mai haɗama don cin hanci kan rushe ƙasar.

title: Karin Magana 29:5
content: 5 Duk wanda yake wa maƙwabcinsa daɗin baki yana sa wa ƙafafunsa tarko ne.

title: Karin Magana 29:6
content: 6 Mugun mutum tarko ne ta wurin zunubinsa, amma mai adalci zai iya rera ya kuma yi murna.

title: Karin Magana 29:7
content: 7 Masu adalci sun damu game da adalci don talakawa, amma mugaye ba su da wannan damuwa.

title: Karin Magana 29:8
content: 8 Masu ba’a kan kuta faɗa a birni, amma masu hikima sukan kwantar da fushi.

title: Karin Magana 29:9
content: 9 In mai hikima ya je wurin shari’a da wawa, wawa kan yi ta fushi yana ta dariya, ba kuwa za a sami salama ba.

title: Karin Magana 29:10
content: 10 Masu kisankai sukan ƙi mutum mai mutunci su kuma nema su kashe mai aikata gaskiya.

title: Karin Magana 29:11
content: 11 Wawa yakan nuna fushinsa a fili, amma mai hikima kan kanne fushinsa.

title: Karin Magana 29:12
content: 12 In mai mulki yana sauraran ƙarairayi, dukan ma’aikatansa za su zama mugaye.

title: Karin Magana 29:13
content: 13 Matalauci da azzalumi suna da wannan abu ɗaya. Ubangiji ne yake ba dukansu gani.

title: Karin Magana 29:14
content: 14 In sarki yana hukunta talakawa da adalci kursiyinsa kullum zai kasance lafiya.

title: Karin Magana 29:15
content: 15 Sandar gyara kan ba da hikima, amma yaron da aka bari ba horo kan jawo kunya ga mahaifiyarsa.

title: Karin Magana 29:16
content: 16 Sa’ad da mugaye suke cin nasara, haka zunubi zai yi ta ƙaruwa, amma masu adalci za su ga fāɗuwar waɗannan mutane.

title: Karin Magana 29:17
content: 17 Ka hori ɗanka, zai kuwa ba ka salama; zai ba ka farin cikin da kake so.

title: Karin Magana 29:18
content: 18 Inda ba wahayi, mutane kan kangare; amma masu albarka ne waɗanda suke kiyaye doka.

title: Karin Magana 29:19
content: 19 Ba a yi wa bawa gyara ta wurin magana kawai; ko da ya fahimta ma, ba zai kula ba.

title: Karin Magana 29:20
content: 20 Ka ga mutum mai yin magana da garaje? To, gara a sa zuciya ga wawa da a sa zuciya gare shi.

title: Karin Magana 29:21
content: 21 In mutum ya yi wa bawansa shagwaɓa tun yana yaro, zai jawo baƙin ciki a ƙarshe.

title: Karin Magana 29:22
content: 22 Mutum mai cika fushi yakan tā da faɗa, mai zafin rai kuma kan yi zunubai masu yawa.

title: Karin Magana 29:23
content: 23 Fariyar mutum kan jawo masa ƙasƙanci amma mai sauƙinkai kan sami girmamawa.

title: Karin Magana 29:24
content: 24 Duk wanda yake abokin ɓarawo abokin gāban kansa ne; yana jin sa yana ta rantsuwa, amma bai isa ya ce kome ba.

title: Karin Magana 29:25
content: 25 Jin tsoron mutum tarko ne, amma duk wanda ya dogara ga Ubangiji zai zauna lafiya.

title: Karin Magana 29:26
content: 26 Mutane sukan nemi samun farin jini daga wurin sarki, amma daga wurin Ubangiji ne mutum kan sami adalci.

title: Karin Magana 29:27
content: 27 Masu adalci suna ƙyamar masu rashin gaskiya; mugaye sukan yi ƙyamar masu aikata gaskiya.

title: Karin Magana 30:1
content: 1 Maganganun Agur ɗan Yake, magana ce horarriya. Wannan mutum ya furta wa Itiyel da kuma ga Ukal,

title: Karin Magana 30:2
content: 2 “Ni ne mafi jahilci a cikin mutane; ba ni da fahimi irin na mutum.

title: Karin Magana 30:3
content: 3 Ban koyi hikima ba, ba ni kuma da sani game da Mai Tsarkin nan,

title: Karin Magana 30:4
content: 4 Wane ne ya taɓa haura zuwa sama ya dawo? Wane ne ya tattara iska a tafin hannuwansa? Wane ne ya nannaɗe ruwaye a cikin rigarsa? Wane ne ya kafa dukan iyakokin duniya? Mene ne sunansa, da kuma sunan ɗansa? Faɗa mini in ka sani!

title: Karin Magana 30:5
content: 5 “Kowace maganar Allah ba ta da kuskure; shi ne garkuwa ga waɗanda suke neman mafaka daga gare shi.

title: Karin Magana 30:6
content: 6 Kada ka ƙara ga maganarsa, in ba haka ba zai tsawata maka ya kuma nuna kai maƙaryaci ne.

title: Karin Magana 30:7
content: 7 “Abu biyu ina roƙonka, ya Ubangiji; kada ka hana ni kafin in mutu.

title: Karin Magana 30:8
content: 8 Ka kawar da ƙarya da kuma ƙarairayi nesa da ni; kada ka ba ni talauci ko arziki, amma ka ba ni abincina na yini kaɗai.

title: Karin Magana 30:9
content: 9 In ba haka ba, zan wadace in ƙi ka har in ce, ‘Wane ne Ubangiji?’ Ko kuwa in zama matalauci in yi sata ta haka in kunyata sunan Allahna.

title: Karin Magana 30:10
content: 10 “Kada ka baza ƙarairayi game da bawa ga maigidansa, in ba haka ba, zai la’ance ka, za ka kuwa sha wahala a kan haka.

title: Karin Magana 30:11
content: 11 “Akwai waɗanda sukan zagi mahaifinsu ba sa kuma sa wa mahaifiyarsu albarka;

title: Karin Magana 30:12
content: 12 waɗanda sukan ɗauka su tsarkaka ne a ganinsu alhali kuwa ƙazamai ne su;

title: Karin Magana 30:13
content: 13 waɗanda kullum idanunsu masu kallon reni ne, waɗanda kallon da suke yi na daurin gira ne;

title: Karin Magana 30:14
content: 14 waɗanda haƙoransu takuba ne waɗanda kuma muƙamuƙansu tarin wuƙaƙe ne don su cinye matalauta daga duniya da kuma mabukata daga cikin mutane.

title: Karin Magana 30:15
content: 15 “Matsattsaku tana da ’ya’ya mata biyu. Suna kuka suna cewa, ‘Ba ni! Ba ni!’ “Akwai abubuwa uku da ba sa taɓa ƙoshi, guda huɗu ba sa taɓa cewa, ‘Ya isa!’

title: Karin Magana 30:16
content: 16 Kabari, mahaifar da ba ta haihuwa, ƙasa, wadda ba ta taɓa ƙoshi da ruwa, da kuma wuta, wadda ba ta taɓa cewa ‘Ya isa!’

title: Karin Magana 30:17
content: 17 “Idon da yake yi wa mahaifi ba’a, wanda yake wa mahaifiya dariyar rashin biyayya, hankakin kwari za su ƙwaƙule masa ido, ungulai za su cinye su.

title: Karin Magana 30:18
content: 18 “Akwai abubuwa uku da suke ba ni mamaki, abubuwa huɗu da ba na iya fahimtarsu,

title: Karin Magana 30:19
content: 19 yadda gaggafa take firiya a sararin sama, yadda maciji yake tafiya a kan dutse, yadda jirgin ruwa yake tafiya a teku, da kuma sha’ani tsakanin namiji da ’ya mace.

title: Karin Magana 30:20
content: 20 “Ga yadda mazinaciya take yi. Takan ci ta share bakinta ta ce, ‘Ban yi wani abu marar kyau ba.’

title: Karin Magana 30:21
content: 21 “Akwai abubuwa uku da duniya kan yi rawan jiki, abubuwa huɗu da ba ta iya jurewa,

title: Karin Magana 30:22
content: 22 bawan da ya zama sarki, wawan da ya ƙoshi da abinci,

title: Karin Magana 30:23
content: 23 macen da ba a ƙauna wadda ta sami miji, da kuma baiwar da ta ɗauki matsayin uwargijiyarta.

title: Karin Magana 30:24
content: 24 “Akwai abubuwa huɗu a duniya da suke ƙanana, duk da haka suna da hikima ƙwarai.

title: Karin Magana 30:25
content: 25 Kyashi halittu ne da ba su da ƙarfi sosai, duk da haka suna ajiyar abincinsu da rani;

title: Karin Magana 30:26
content: 26 remaye halittu ne da ba su da ƙarfi sosai, duk da haka sukan yi gidajensu a duwatsu;

title: Karin Magana 30:27
content: 27 fāra ba su da sarki, duk da haka suna tafiya tare bisa ga girma;

title: Karin Magana 30:28
content: 28 ana iya kama ƙadangare da hannu, duk da haka akan same shi a fadodin sarakuna.

title: Karin Magana 30:29
content: 29 “Akwai abubuwa uku da suke jan jiki da kuma taƙama a tafiyarsu abubuwa huɗu waɗanda suke kwarjini da taƙama a tafiyarsu,

title: Karin Magana 30:30
content: 30 zaki mai ƙarfi a cikin namun jeji, wanda ba ya ratse wa kowa;

title: Karin Magana 30:31
content: 31 zakara mai taƙama, da bunsuru, da kuma sarki mai sojoji kewaye da shi.

title: Karin Magana 30:32
content: 32 “In ka yi wauta ka kuma ɗaukaka kanka, ko kuwa wani yana ƙulla maka mugunta, ka dāfa hannunka a bisa bakinka!

title: Karin Magana 30:33
content: 33 Gama kamar yadda kaɗaɗɗen madara takan kawo mai, murɗa hanci kuma takan sa a yi haɓo, haka tsokanar fushi takan kawo faɗa.”

title: Karin Magana 31:1
content: 1 Maganganun Sarki Lemuwel, magana ce horarriya mahaifiyarsa ta koya masa,

title: Karin Magana 31:2
content: 2 “Ka saurara, ya ɗana! Ka saurara, ɗan cikina! Ka saurara, ya ɗan amshin addu’ata!

title: Karin Magana 31:3
content: 3 Kada ka ba da ƙarfinka a kan mata, ƙarfinka ga waɗanda suka hallaka sarakuna.

title: Karin Magana 31:4
content: 4 “Ba na sarakuna ba ne, ya Lemuwel, ba na sarakuna ba ne su sha ruwan inabi, ba na masu mulki ba ne su yi marmarin barasa,

title: Karin Magana 31:5
content: 5 don kada su sha su manta da abin da doka ta umarta, su hana wa waɗanda aka danne hakkinsu.

title: Karin Magana 31:6
content: 6 A ba da barasa ga waɗanda suke cikin halin ƙaƙa naka yi, ruwan inabi ga waɗanda suke cikin wahala;

title: Karin Magana 31:7
content: 7 bari su sha su manta da talaucinsu kada kuma su ƙara tunawa da ɓacin ransu.

title: Karin Magana 31:8
content: 8 “Yi magana domin bebaye, domin hakkin dukan waɗanda suke naƙasassu.

title: Karin Magana 31:9
content: 9 Yi magana a kuma yi shari’ar adalci; a tsare hakkin talakawa da masu bukata.”

title: Karin Magana 31:10
content: 10 Wa yake iya samun mace mai halin kirki? Darajarta ta fi ta lu’ulu’ai.

title: Karin Magana 31:11
content: 11 Mijinta yana da cikakken amincewa da ita kuma ba ya rasa wani abu mai daraja.

title: Karin Magana 31:12
content: 12 Takan yi masa alheri ba mugunta ba, dukan kwanakin ranta.

title: Karin Magana 31:13
content: 13 Takan zaɓi ulu da lilin ta yi ta saƙa da hannuwanta da farin ciki.

title: Karin Magana 31:14
content: 14 Ita kamar jirgin ’yan kasuwa ne tana kawo abincinta daga nesa.

title: Karin Magana 31:15
content: 15 Takan farka tun da sauran duhu; ta tanada wa iyalinta abinci ta kuma shirya wa ’yan matan gidanta ayyukan da za su yi.

title: Karin Magana 31:16
content: 16 Takan lura da gona sosai ta kuma saye ta; daga abin da take samu na kuɗin shiga take shuka gonar inabi.

title: Karin Magana 31:17
content: 17 Takan himmantu tă yi aikinta tuƙuru; hannuwanta suna da ƙarfi domin ayyukanta.

title: Karin Magana 31:18
content: 18 Takan tabbata akwai riba a kasuwancinta, kuma fitilarta ba ya mutuwa da dare.

title: Karin Magana 31:19
content: 19 Da hannunta take riƙe abin kaɗi ta kuma kama abin saƙa da yatsotsinta.

title: Karin Magana 31:20
content: 20 Takan marabci talakawa takan kuma taimaki masu bukata.

title: Karin Magana 31:21
content: 21 Sa’ad da ƙanƙara ta fāɗi, ba ta jin tsoro saboda gidanta; gama dukansu suna da tufafi masu kauri.

title: Karin Magana 31:22
content: 22 Takan yi wa gadonta kayan shimfiɗa; tufafinta kuma na lilin ne mai laushi na shunayya.

title: Karin Magana 31:23
content: 23 Ana girmama mijinta a ƙofar shiga birni inda yakan zauna a cikin dattawan gari.

title: Karin Magana 31:24
content: 24 Takan yi riguna na lilin ta sayar; takan kuma sayar wa ’yan kasuwa da ɗamara.

title: Karin Magana 31:25
content: 25 Ƙarfi da mutunci su ne suturarta; za tă iya yin dariyar kwanaki masu zuwa.

title: Karin Magana 31:26
content: 26 Tana magana da hikima, kuma umarnai mai aminci yana a harshenta.

title: Karin Magana 31:27
content: 27 Tana lura da sha’anin gidanta kuma ba ta cin abincin ƙyuya.

title: Karin Magana 31:28
content: 28 ’Ya’yanta sukan tashi su ce da ita mai albarka; haka mijinta ma, yakan kuma yabe ta yana cewa,

title: Karin Magana 31:29
content: 29 “Mata da yawa suna yin abubuwan yabo, amma ke kin fi su duka.”

title: Karin Magana 31:30
content: 30 Kayan tsari yana ruɗu, kyau kuma kan shuɗe; amma mace mai tsoron Ubangiji abar yabo ce.

title: Karin Magana 31:31
content: 31 Ka ba ta ladar da ya dace tă samo wa kanta, bari kuma ayyukanta su kawo mata yabo a ƙofar shiga birni.
